0084148c9296.en: “There you go, Harry! Now let’s get cracking!” A fatherly smile appeared on Itagiba’s face as he herded the stranger, now named Harry, away from the southwest tower he had come from, towards two other identical towers not far away.
0084148c9296.t: “Hah, itu dia, Harry! Jom kita mulakan!” Senyuman kebapaan muncul di wajah Itagiba ketika dia menggiring orang asing itu, kini bernama Harry, menjauhi menara barat daya tempat dia datang, menuju ke dua menara lain yang serupa tidak jauh dari situ.

019009103f45.en: “So that’s a toilet?” Harry saw the light coming from the stone completely falter as Sora dumped the water down the toilet.
019009103f45.t: “Jadi itu tandas?” Harry melihat cahaya dari batu itu padam sepenuhnya ketika Sora membuang air itu ke dalam tandas.

01ad690e5152.en: “That’s us, bud! Long story, though, and I need to go get your badge ready. Sora, can you put extra soap in the bathwater?” A grin arose on Itagiba, the Sanbi King. “He’s gonna need it.”
01ad690e5152.t: “Itulah kita, bro! Tapi cerita panjang, dan aku kena pergi siapkan lencana kau. Sora, boleh kau letak sabun lebih dalam air mandi tu?” Satu sengihan muncul pada Itagiba, Raja Sanbi. “Dia akan perlukannya.”

0564758476ed.en: His brow furrowed. A strong stench of death mixed with a strong oily musk raped his nose, burning deep like taking a big whiff of bleach; his bronchioles deep within his lungs screamed in agony. With no warning, he suddenly sneezed his brains out, popping their eyes out of their sockets—at least that's what the sensation of pain felt like as no actual brain matter came out, nor did his eyes free themselves.
0564758476ed.t: Dahinya berkerut. Bau busuk kematian yang kuat bercampur bau kasturi berminyak yang pekat merogol hidungnya, membakar jauh ke dalam seperti menyedut peluntur dengan kuat; bronkiol jauh di dalam paru-parunya menjerit kesakitan. Tanpa amaran, dia tiba-tiba bersin seolah-olah otaknya terhambur, membuatkan matanya tersembul dari soket—sekurang-kurangnya begitulah rasa sakitnya kerana tiada otak yang sebenarnya keluar, dan matanya juga tidak terlepas.

05fe38f53863.en: “It’s a half timehunk, sir.” Sora opened another drawer, and grabbed a round metal object, opened it in half, and pointed it against the window. “Have you ever seen a timekeeper before?”
05fe38f53863.t: “Ia separuh timehunk, tuan.” Sora membuka laci lain, dan mengambil objek logam bulat, membukanya separuh, dan menghalakannya ke tingkap. “Pernahkah tuan melihat timekeeper sebelum ini?”

072038900e0b.en: Her cheerfully cyan eyes were like pearls, but those pearly eyes did not dare gaze at him, instead she gazed towards the cityscape in the backdrop of the window beside them. “Hi King! Is this gentleman the new guest?” Her voice was a sweetly feminine voice that sounded like a lullaby—a rap lullaby that she ended with a stiff posture, anxiously waiting for orders.
072038900e0b.t: Matanya yang biru kehijauan dan ceria bagaikan mutiara, tetapi mata seperti mutiara itu tidak berani menatapnya, sebaliknya dia memandang ke arah pemandangan kota di latar tingkap di sebelah mereka. “Hai Tuanku! Adakah tuan ini tetamu baharu itu?” Suaranya suara feminin yang manis yang kedengaran seperti dodoian—dodoian rap yang diakhirinya dengan postur kaku, menunggu arahan dengan cemas.

082320fe85df.en: A crunchy sound, followed by an orgasmic hum came out of the lard ass entertaining himself. The taco, filled with carne asada, lettuce, tomatoes, and thick chunks of cheddar, became a single mush of flavor explosion in his mouth, all brought together by chimichurri sauce. But the flavor explosion didn’t last long, for it was quickly sent down his gullet by a refreshing, frizzy light ale that had a slightly bitter and malty taste that gave way into a slightly sweet aftertaste.
082320fe85df.t: Bunyi rangup, diikuti dengungan penuh nikmat keluar daripada si gemuk lemak yang sedang menghiburkan dirinya. Taco itu, berisi carne asada, salad, tomato dan ketulan tebal keju cheddar, menjadi satu letupan rasa yang lumat di dalam mulutnya, semuanya disatukan oleh sos chimichurri. Tetapi letupan rasa itu tidak bertahan lama, kerana ia cepat-cepat dihantar ke kerongkongnya oleh bir ale ringan yang menyegarkan dan berbuih, yang mempunyai rasa sedikit pahit dan bermalt sebelum berganti dengan rasa akhir yang sedikit manis.

09f013ffb206.en: Ask her to wash your back. Itagiba’s voice came to his mind again, but Harry blew the idea off with a quick head shake. There’s no way I can ask her that.
09f013ffb206.t: Minta dia gosokkan belakang kau. Suara Itagiba terlintas lagi di fikirannya, tetapi Harry menepis idea itu dengan gelengan kepala yang pantas. Mustahil aku boleh minta macam tu.

0a366c9227e2.en: Tears poured out of his eyes as he felt nothingness taking his last memory away from him. Amidst the tears flowing through his greasy cheeks, a white sparkle of light appeared in the distance, moving randomly, with disregard to the laws of physics, searching for something as if it was a UFO in the sky. One second it was barely the size of a penny, then next it was the size of a car as it zoomed around in the darkness, appearing as if searching for something.
0a366c9227e2.t: Air mata mencurah dari matanya ketika dia merasakan kekosongan merampas ingatan terakhirnya. Di tengah-tengah air mata yang mengalir di pipinya yang berminyak, satu percikan cahaya putih muncul di kejauhan, bergerak secara rawak, tanpa mengendahkan hukum fizik, mencari sesuatu seolah-olah ia UFO di langit. Sesaat ia hampir tidak sebesar syiling, kemudian saat berikutnya ia sebesar kereta ketika ia meluncur ke sana ke mari dalam kegelapan, kelihatan seperti sedang mencari sesuatu.

0a4f4b8d9b9b.en: “Don’t step on them or she’s gonna get cranky!” Itagiba warned as he stepped carefully around them.
0a4f4b8d9b9b.t: “Jangan pijak, nanti dia meragam!” Itagiba memberi amaran sambil melangkah berhati-hati mengelilinginya.

0ab14db837a5.en: Feeling violated, the stranger covered his belly button, nervously laughing along with Itagiba. Ehh? That’s weird.
0ab14db837a5.t: Terasa dicabul, orang asing itu menutup pusatnya, ketawa gugup bersama Itagiba. Ehh? Peliknya.

0ccb1cf8bdba.en: A slightly cold breeze flooded the room, bringing a salty air alongside the noisy rustles of the vibrating city down below. With a large breath of fresh air, Harry felt the stagnant air come out of his lungs. Damm. Those taco farts are still just as bad—wait—didn’t I have my own place too? Harry, looking at the blur of houses in this foreign city, tried to juggle his memory, but the only thing that appeared was a resemblance of a red recliner, and a TV in front of it. What happened to it? Did I lose all my money, then end up in the slums? But then why can't I remember anything? Is that why everything feels so off?
0ccb1cf8bdba.t: Angin yang agak sejuk membanjiri bilik itu, membawa udara masin bersama riuh-rendah kota yang bergetar di bawah. Dengan tarikan nafas udara segar yang dalam, Harry merasakan udara yang bertakung keluar dari paru-parunya. Sial. Kentut taco tu masih teruk macam dulu—kejap—bukan ke aku ada rumah sendiri juga? Harry, memandang kekaburan rumah-rumah di kota asing ini, cuba menyusun ingatannya, tetapi satu-satunya yang muncul hanyalah bayangan kerusi malas merah, dan TV di hadapannya. Apa jadi dengan rumah tu? Aku hilang semua duit aku, lepas tu berakhir kat setinggan ke? Tapi kenapa aku tak ingat apa-apa? Sebab tu ke semuanya terasa tak kena?

0ec97c84affd.en: An offbeat smile shone on Neferteri, appearing to partake in enjoying this stranger’s misfortune. With a joyous tone, she spoke slowly, “Don’t despair. Please take solace in the fact that we do know some facts about you.”
0ec97c84affd.t: Senyuman ganjil bersinar pada Neferteri, kelihatan turut menikmati nasib malang orang asing ini. Dengan nada gembira, dia bercakap perlahan-lahan, “Jangan berputus asa. Tenangkanlah hati dengan hakikat bahawa kami memang mengetahui beberapa fakta tentang kamu.”

0f20b0f36579.en: “A—a race, like the Naked Bruntos, sir?” Sora replied in an inquisitive tone of her own.
0f20b0f36579.t: “Sa—satu bangsa, macam Naked Bruntos, tuan?” Sora menjawab dengan nada ingin tahu tersendiri.

0f39c383bfdb.en: “Oh! I’m sorry!” Harry flipped the lamp upright again, rattling the stones even more.
0f39c383bfdb.t: “Oh! Maaf!” Harry menterbalikkan lampu itu semula, menggegarkan batu-batu itu lebih kuat.

10ed3829c5cc.en: Harry, huffing as he carefully watched his step, reached the midway point of the second flight of stairs. From the corners of his eyes, he noticed something quickly walking down towards him; gasping amidst inhaling, he saw a girl far cuter than sexy. Her fiery red hair contrasted her black maid clothing with blue accents. Her small mouth had a charming, embarrassed smile, and two cutesy canines poking from below that looked like inverted vampire fangs. Her flushed skin was so visible that it appeared as if she had rosacea.
10ed3829c5cc.t: Harry, tercungap-cungap sambil memerhati langkahnya dengan teliti, sampai di pertengahan tangga tingkat kedua. Dari ekor matanya, dia perasan sesuatu berjalan laju turun ke arahnya; tercungap di tengah-tengah menarik nafas, dia nampak seorang gadis yang jauh lebih comel daripada seksi. Rambut merahnya yang menyala kontras dengan pakaian pembantu rumah hitamnya yang berhias biru. Mulutnya yang kecil mempunyai senyuman malu yang menawan, dan dua gigi taring comel menjengul dari bawah yang kelihatan seperti taring pontianak terbalik. Kulitnya yang merah padam begitu ketara sehingga kelihatan seolah-olah dia menghidap rosasea.

141d320ad979.en: A hum came out of Harry, his hand scratching the short stubble beard of his. “I’m sorry, but what is Darfaries?—”
141d320ad979.t: Satu dengungan keluar daripada Harry, tangannya menggaru janggut pendeknya yang kasar. “Maaf, tapi apa itu Darfaries?—”

1446bfee3acf.en: “I—dunno?” The stranger spoke, revealing his hands, shrugging until he remembered the stone he found in the ground earlier. I guess that has a nice sound to it. “Nari?”
1446bfee3acf.t: “S—saya tak tahu?” Orang asing itu bercakap, menunjukkan tangannya, mengangkat bahu sehinggalah dia teringat batu yang ditemuinya di lantai tadi. Rasanya bunyinya sedap juga. “Nari?”

15933339b31d.en: “Hehe—that’s a new one—hey—remember to save it for Maiara as that’s why you’re here.” With a wink and a thin-lipped devious smile, Itagiba slapped Harry’s arm twice, then went his way down the stairs, only to turn his head back towards him. “By the way, you missed an opportunity to grab her hands, and give them a kiss.” Itagiba gave a smooth fingerbang, with a click of the tongue, then started walking down again. With his back to Harry, he said out loud, “But you can still ask her to wash your back! I will allow that!” He gave a thumbs up, disappearing into the stairs below.
15933339b31d.t: “Hehe—yang tu baru—hei—ingat simpan untuk Maiara sebab itulah kau ada kat sini.” Dengan kenyitan mata dan senyuman nakal berbibir nipis, Itagiba menampar lengan Harry dua kali, kemudian turun tangga, hanya untuk memalingkan kepalanya semula ke arahnya. “By the way, kau terlepas peluang nak pegang tangan dia, dan cium.” Itagiba membuat gaya menunjuk jari yang bergaya, dengan decitan lidah, kemudian mula turun semula. Membelakangi Harry, dia berkata dengan kuat, “Tapi kau masih boleh minta dia gosokkan belakang kau! Aku benarkan!” Dia mengangkat ibu jari, lenyap ke tangga di bawah.

15d746c69715.en: This other floor was different from the others. The room itself was an open concept room split into two sides, with a corridor in the middle blocked by an old-looking wheelbarrow that led to a large door on the opposite side. On the left, flesh, bone, and feathers pickled in bottles of who-knows-what were all stacked up to the ceiling against the wall. In front of them, small and large cauldrons, workbenches, and knives stood closer to the corridor—truly a witch’s wet dream. What the fuck is all this? The stranger felt as if he just entered a haunted house, where everything felt unnatural or surreal.
15d746c69715.t: Tingkat yang satu lagi ini berbeza daripada yang lain. Bilik itu sendiri ialah bilik konsep terbuka yang terbahagi kepada dua bahagian, dengan koridor di tengah yang dihalang oleh kereta sorong yang kelihatan lama yang menuju ke pintu besar di sebelah bertentangan. Di sebelah kiri, daging, tulang dan bulu yang dijeruk dalam botol entah berisi apa semuanya disusun hingga ke siling di dinding. Di hadapannya, kawah kecil dan besar, meja kerja, dan pisau berdiri lebih dekat dengan koridor—benar-benar impian basah seorang ahli sihir. Apa benda celaka semua ni? Orang asing itu merasakan seolah-olah dia baru masuk ke rumah berhantu, di mana segala-galanya terasa luar biasa atau tidak nyata.

1686703b94cf.en: He felt his gut churn as one last memory rose, appearing as if it was unlocked, his soul unable to kept it protected any longer—he was a young skinny boy, back in his lovely childhood home, with a large grin on his face as he sat in between his parents, eating tacos, while a black-and-white chubby dog begged for food at their feet.
1686703b94cf.t: Dia merasakan perutnya bergelora ketika satu ingatan terakhir timbul, seolah-olah ia baru terbuka kuncinya, jiwanya tidak lagi mampu melindunginya—dia seorang budak lelaki kurus, kembali di rumah zaman kanak-kanaknya yang indah, dengan senyuman lebar di wajahnya sambil duduk di antara ibu bapanya, makan taco, sementara seekor anjing tembam hitam putih meminta-minta makanan di kaki mereka.

168ed133b7ff.en: Wait. Eleven is smaller than thirteen. The stranger computed the numbers on his head, trying to make sense of it all, at least until he saw Itagiba look at him and wink. Ohhhhh. I think I get it. The stranger kept muddling over the wink, and possible interpretations.
168ed133b7ff.t: Kejap. Sebelas lebih kecil daripada tiga belas. Orang asing itu mengira nombor-nombor itu dalam kepalanya, cuba memahaminya, sekurang-kurangnya sehingga dia melihat Itagiba memandangnya dan mengenyit mata. Ohhhhh. Rasanya aku faham. Orang asing itu terus memikirkan kenyitan mata itu, dan tafsiran-tafsiran yang mungkin.

1706d20b8f19.en: The stranger gulped. “I—I remember me and my parents were eating tacos when I was a kid—” The stranger felt the darkness come alive, grappling his heart, suffocating his lungs, but it was nothing but a vivid memory. “We’re watching—”
1706d20b8f19.t: Orang asing itu menelan liur. “S—saya ingat saya dan ibu bapa saya makan taco masa saya kecil—” Orang asing itu merasakan kegelapan hidup semula, mencengkam jantungnya, menyesakkan paru-parunya, tetapi ia hanyalah ingatan yang jelas. “Kami tengah tengok—”

17eec29c1831.en: Sora looked up, towards the ceiling, “Eight. Sixteen, with quarter time hunk would be thirty-two in a day. I’m truly sorry, sir, but I do not know what twenty-four hours correlate to.” Sora’s toothy lips saddened, holding the fost lamp at her side, taking a longer bow.
17eec29c1831.t: Sora mendongak, ke arah siling, “Lapan. Enam belas, dengan suku time hunk jadi tiga puluh dua dalam sehari. Saya betul-betul minta maaf, tuan, tapi saya tidak tahu dua puluh empat jam itu bersamaan dengan apa.” Bibir Sora yang bergigi kelihatan sedih, memegang lampu fost di sisinya, menunduk lebih lama.

18313572d40e.en: “Ohhhh!” Harry murmured to himself, analyzing what initially appeared to be a circular makeup palette. There were eight color zones in the circle, with a blue emblem of an engraved fish sticking out in the middle. The four colors on the left were warmer in nature, while the right ones were cooler. Within each of those eight colors, there was a white word splitting the color in two. Harry read them clockwise as Monna, Monni, Monno, Munnu, Sunna, Sunni, Sunno, Sunnu. “This feels—pretty different. Wait—why is this chunk kinda lightened up?” Harry noticed half of one of the colors, at around ten o'clock, having a certain bioluminescence to it. It contrasted the other half, divided by a word that spelled out Sunno, with a darker orange color, akin to the inside of a pink grapefruit.
18313572d40e.t: “Ohhhh!” Harry bergumam sendirian, menganalisis apa yang pada mulanya kelihatan seperti palet solek bulat. Ada lapan zon warna dalam bulatan itu, dengan lambang biru seekor ikan yang diukir menonjol di tengah. Empat warna di sebelah kiri bersifat lebih hangat, manakala yang di kanan lebih sejuk. Dalam setiap lapan warna itu, ada satu perkataan putih membahagikan warna itu kepada dua. Harry membacanya mengikut arah jam sebagai Monna, Monni, Monno, Munnu, Sunna, Sunni, Sunno, Sunnu. “Ni rasa—agak berbeza. Kejap—kenapa bahagian ni macam menyala sikit?” Harry perasan separuh daripada salah satu warna, kira-kira pada pukul sepuluh, mempunyai biopendarcahaya tertentu. Ia kontras dengan separuh lagi, dibahagikan oleh perkataan yang mengeja Sunno, dengan warna jingga yang lebih gelap, seperti isi limau gedang merah jambu.

185b4e7d7173.en: Making his way up to the fourth floor, he was panting as if he was about to have a heart attack. Exchanging quick eye contact with a portable-size cutesy maid called Sora, Harry smiled, wiping the sweat off his forehead.
185b4e7d7173.t: Mendaki ke tingkat empat, dia tercungap-cungap seolah-olah hendak diserang sakit jantung. Bertukar pandangan pantas dengan seorang pembantu rumah comel bersaiz mudah alih bernama Sora, Harry tersenyum, mengesat peluh di dahinya.

1912782ccd41.en: Despite the bustling city noises coming from outside the walls, an eerie silence ensued; everyone stood by, eager to know more, even Nina, the child in pink, and the black soulless eyes of the “Extra THICC” goth chicken she was mounted on—at least it appeared interested for a little bit, as it then quickly bobbled its head towards the ground to peck at something. The stranger admired the sheer size of the maybe-more-emo-than-goth chicken, almost as tall as the child in pink. “Ahhhh—I woke up in that tower?” The stranger pointed to the tower he just came out of.
1912782ccd41.t: Walaupun bunyi kota yang sibuk datang dari luar tembok, kesunyian yang ganjil menyusul; semua orang berdiri di situ, ingin tahu lebih lanjut, malah Nina, kanak-kanak berbaju merah jambu, dan mata hitam tanpa jiwa ayam goth “Extra THICC” yang ditungganginya—sekurang-kurangnya ia kelihatan berminat seketika, sebelum cepat-cepat mengangguk-anggukkan kepalanya ke tanah untuk mematuk sesuatu. Orang asing itu mengagumi saiz ayam yang mungkin lebih emo daripada goth itu, hampir setinggi kanak-kanak berbaju merah jambu itu. “Ahhhh—saya tersedar dalam menara tu?” Orang asing itu menunjuk ke menara yang baru dia keluari.

199adea1f9af.en: At the top of the spiraling stairs, his vision could not distinguish where one step started and the other ended, and it felt like a long way down if he dared to misstep. He held onto the blue, with accents of drying blood rails, as if his life depended on it. One step after the other, he made his way halfway down the flight of stairs, to another open window inviting him to see outside. He saw the same blurry bustling city from another angle, yet he could not recognize anything remotely familiar.
199adea1f9af.t: Di puncak tangga berpusar, penglihatannya tidak dapat membezakan di mana satu anak tangga bermula dan yang lain berakhir, dan terasa sangat jauh ke bawah jika dia berani tersalah langkah. Dia berpaut pada pemegang tangga biru, yang dihiasi kesan darah yang mengering, seolah-olah nyawanya bergantung padanya. Selangkah demi selangkah, dia turun separuh daripada tangga itu, ke sebuah lagi tingkap terbuka yang mengajaknya melihat ke luar. Dia nampak kota sibuk yang kabur itu dari sudut lain, namun dia tidak dapat mengecam apa-apa yang sedikit pun biasa.

19b0a8f2f083.en: “THIRTEEN!” Itagiba shouted back, so enthusiastically that the stranger felt he was in the middle of a stock exchange.
19b0a8f2f083.t: “TIGA BELAS!” Itagiba menjerit balas, begitu bersemangat sehingga orang asing itu merasa seperti berada di tengah-tengah bursa saham.

1a47850f3ee1.en: “You’re just like us, bud. I guess you’ve never seen a Wozefaries before, huh? Lemme tell ya, Sora is one of the cutest out there—right Sora?” Itagiba gave a wink to her.
1a47850f3ee1.t: “Kau sama macam kami, bro. Rasanya kau tak pernah nampak Wozefaries sebelum ni, ya? Biar aku bagi tahu, Sora antara yang paling comel kat luar sana—kan Sora?” Itagiba mengenyit mata kepadanya.

1c2c84f342c9.en: Harry watched the blur of this foreign city, and the people going about their business, while his mind slowly drew distant with conflicting thoughts, and no single solid answer.
1c2c84f342c9.t: Harry memerhati kekaburan kota asing ini, dan orang ramai yang sibuk dengan urusan mereka, sementara fikirannya perlahan-lahan melayang jauh dengan fikiran yang bercanggah, dan tiada satu pun jawapan yang kukuh.

1d20dee562d5.en: Eori was the first to pull her hand off the shake. Twitching her nose in disgust, she stepped back and put a fair amount of distance between them. Next, she seemed to isolate her hand from touching anywhere else in her body—acting like she had just touched a leper.
1d20dee562d5.t: Eori yang pertama menarik tangannya dari salam itu. Mengerutkan hidung kerana jijik, dia berundur dan meletakkan jarak yang agak jauh antara mereka. Kemudian, dia kelihatan mengasingkan tangannya daripada menyentuh mana-mana bahagian lain tubuhnya—berkelakuan seolah-olah dia baru menyentuh pesakit kusta.

1df312cf60d0.en: Harry, glancing at a blur that was Sora’s small hands, caught a red thing on the back of both of them. He worryingly pointed at it, his voice followed next “Ahhh—is that blood? Are you okay?”
1df312cf60d0.t: Harry, mengerling kekaburan yang merupakan tangan kecil Sora, ternampak sesuatu yang merah di belakang kedua-dua tangannya. Dia menunjuk ke arahnya dengan risau, suaranya menyusul “Ahhh—itu darah ke? Awak okey?”

1eb69c0eec21.en: With widened eyes at the TV, his laugh turned into gasp. Without looking away, his grubby hands felt around three tacos to his right, knowing exactly what the flavors were: carne asada, campechanos, and chorizo. Feeling adventurous, he selected the campechanos this time as every time he chewed on it, he felt a burst of a unique combination of leftover meat, plus special seasonings like cumin and cilantro, that his favorite taco shop would create—like opening a loot box, but rather than useless crap; it was a unique flavor experience.
1eb69c0eec21.t: Dengan mata terbeliak ke arah TV, ketawanya bertukar menjadi tercungap. Tanpa mengalihkan pandangan, tangannya yang comot meraba-raba tiga taco di sebelah kanannya, tahu dengan tepat apa rasanya: carne asada, campechanos dan chorizo. Rasa ingin mencuba, kali ini dia memilih campechanos kerana setiap kali dia mengunyahnya, dia merasai letupan gabungan unik daging lebihan, serta perasa istimewa seperti jintan putih dan ketumbar, yang dicipta oleh kedai taco kegemarannya—seperti membuka kotak rampasan, tetapi bukannya sampah tak berguna; ia pengalaman rasa yang unik.

204ec134908e.en: Feeling a sense of nothingness taking over, he clung tightly to his chair, no longer even knowing what color it was, nor its shape. He breathed out, but could no longer breathe in, and the more he tried, the more pain he felt from his collapsing lungs. The pain mutated into sheer agony, bringing the certainty of death to his door, causing his life to flash by in his head. However, the memories did not look vivid, but rather closer to old photos left to rot, barely being able to recognize what the memories were to begin with. He saw places that faintly felt familiar, but as he tried to remember them, he saw many more rotted memories pass by—like an unstoppable train disappearing in the horizon, never to be seen again. With each passing moment of pure darkness and agony, everything he knew, as corrupted as it was, became nothingness.
204ec134908e.t: Merasakan kekosongan mengambil alih, dia berpaut kuat pada kerusinya, tidak lagi tahu apa warnanya, mahupun bentuknya. Dia menghembus nafas, tetapi tidak lagi dapat menarik nafas, dan semakin dia cuba, semakin dia merasakan kesakitan dari paru-parunya yang mengecut. Kesakitan itu bermutasi menjadi seksaan yang amat sangat, membawa kepastian kematian ke depan pintunya, menyebabkan hidupnya terimbas dalam kepalanya. Namun, ingatan-ingatan itu tidak kelihatan jelas, sebaliknya lebih seperti gambar lama yang dibiarkan reput, hampir tidak dapat dikenali apa ingatan itu pada mulanya. Dia melihat tempat-tempat yang samar-samar terasa biasa, tetapi ketika dia cuba mengingatinya, dia melihat lebih banyak lagi ingatan reput berlalu—seperti kereta api yang tidak dapat dihentikan lenyap di kaki langit, tidak akan kelihatan lagi. Setiap detik kegelapan mutlak dan seksaan yang berlalu, segala yang dia tahu, walau serosak mana pun, menjadi kekosongan.

2227f7478bd5.en: Her voice reached Harry’s ears like a rap lullaby, but he then heard another familiar voice echo inside his head. You need to ask her to wash your back! “Can you?—” He tried to say it, but the words choked on his throat when her floppy ears and bright cyan eyes focused her attention on him. “Wash—eh?—I’m sorry. Oh! Humans! Is that the same thing as Naked Bruntos you mentioned early?” Harry let out an anguished breath.
2227f7478bd5.t: Suaranya sampai ke telinga Harry seperti dodoian rap, tetapi kemudian dia mendengar satu lagi suara yang dikenali bergema dalam kepalanya. Kau kena minta dia gosokkan belakang kau! “Boleh tak awak?—” Dia cuba mengatakannya, tetapi kata-kata itu tersekat di kerongkongnya apabila telinga terkulai dan mata biru kehijauan yang terang milik gadis itu menumpukan perhatian kepadanya. “Gosok—eh?—maaf. Oh! Manusia! Itu sama dengan Naked Bruntos yang awak sebut tadi ke?” Harry menghembus nafas dengan resah.

228ea442c32e.en: The stranger felt his heartbeat go up by ten percent for every step Princess Eori came closer to him—his own drama and problems felt being shoved aside by sheer passion. With her standing an arm’s length in front of him, his eyes were now able to tell just how beautiful she actually was. Her face was slightly flushed, but her lips were tightly shut—it looked like she was biting her tongue to hold back something. She extended her hands, and shook his weak-ass grip with the same intensity as her father, but she kept her distance. Oh wow! The stranger felt his heart trying to get out of his own mouth as his cold, sweaty hand was caressed by her warmth. In turn, his grip became not-so-weak-ass while a funny bubbly feeling erupted inside him, further pushing the personal drama into the sidelines.
228ea442c32e.t: Orang asing itu merasakan degupan jantungnya meningkat sepuluh peratus bagi setiap langkah Puteri Eori mendekatinya—drama dan masalahnya sendiri terasa diketepikan oleh ghairah semata-mata. Dengan gadis itu berdiri sedepa di hadapannya, matanya kini dapat melihat betapa cantiknya dia sebenarnya. Wajahnya sedikit merah, tetapi bibirnya terkatup rapat—dia kelihatan seperti menggigit lidah untuk menahan sesuatu. Dia menghulurkan tangannya, dan bersalam dengan genggaman lembik lelaki itu dengan keamatan yang sama seperti ayahandanya, tetapi dia menjaga jaraknya. Oh wow! Orang asing itu merasakan jantungnya cuba keluar dari mulutnya sendiri ketika tangannya yang sejuk dan berpeluh dibelai kehangatannya. Sebagai balasan, genggamannya menjadi tidak-berapa-lembik sementara perasaan berbuih yang lucu meletus dalam dirinya, menolak lagi drama peribadinya ke tepi.

23f89cd7fd28.en: “That, sir? That’s a fost stone lamp.” Playing with her hands, Sora tried to hide away the embarrassment swelling within her. “Excuse my question, but do you know what a couch is?”
23f89cd7fd28.t: “Itu, tuan? Itu lampu fost stone.” Bermain dengan tangannya, Sora cuba menyembunyikan rasa malu yang membengkak dalam dirinya. “Maafkan soalan saya, tapi adakah tuan tahu apa itu sofa?”

251a4719a335.en: With that pressure out of his system, he brought himself back to his original position, and grabbed a chorizo taco, and pigged out on it, followed by another bottle of beer. Meanwhile, the TV’s white light, and it’s kinda-like-heavy-rain noise remained perfectly steady, but its brightness was slowly, but progressively diminishing, letting the darkness encroach closer.
251a4719a335.t: Dengan tekanan itu keluar dari sistemnya, dia kembali ke posisi asal, dan mencapai taco chorizo, lalu melahapnya, diikuti sebotol lagi bir. Sementara itu, cahaya putih TV, dan bunyinya yang seperti-hujan-lebat itu kekal tetap dengan sempurna, tetapi kecerahannya perlahan-lahan, namun secara beransur-ansur berkurangan, membiarkan kegelapan merapat.

2bc56e384b83.en: “Whatever, then—anything else?” Itagiba looked probing towards the stranger, appearing to not take “no” as an answer.
2bc56e384b83.t: “Lantaklah—ada apa-apa lagi?” Itagiba memandang orang asing itu dengan penuh menyiasat, kelihatan tidak mahu menerima “tidak” sebagai jawapan.

2e0845a5b412.en: “Your eyes are that bad, right? Well, grab her hand, and notice the bump. It is more like a nerve than a vein. See?” Itagiba smiled at Sora. “Give him a break, he just woke up from a near soul death.”
2e0845a5b412.t: “Mata kau memang teruk, kan? Haa, pegang tangan dia, dan rasa bonjolan tu. Ia lebih macam saraf daripada urat. Nampak?” Itagiba tersenyum kepada Sora. “Bagi dia peluang sikit, dia baru bangun daripada hampir mati jiwa.”

2ecf20b26a66.en: She said “R” twice in a row, making the same weird symbol. The fifth was a horizontal line that looked like a heart monitor that spiked down, then up-down, then down again. “Y!” She then ended her presentation by putting both hands up, and screaming as loud as she could, “HARRY! YAY!”
2ecf20b26a66.t: Dia menyebut “R” dua kali berturut-turut, membuat simbol pelik yang sama. Yang kelima ialah garis mendatar yang kelihatan seperti monitor jantung yang mencanak ke bawah, kemudian naik-turun, kemudian turun lagi. “Y!” Dia kemudian menamatkan persembahannya dengan mengangkat kedua-dua tangan, dan menjerit sekuat hati, “HARRY! YEAY!”

2ee7b2722402.en: Is that why there was all the blood and such? The stranger thought back to the room he woke up in. He placed his hand on his chest, feeling his pretty-much-alive heartbeat. “—but how am I alive?” The words slipped from his mouth, picturing his own dead body, far fatter than what he actually was, rotting in the slums. “I thought once you die, you actually die.”
2ee7b2722402.t: Sebab tu ke ada darah semua tu? Orang asing itu teringat semula bilik tempat dia tersedar. Dia meletakkan tangannya di dada, merasakan degupan jantungnya yang hidup-hidup sungguh. “—tapi macam mana saya boleh hidup?” Kata-kata itu terlepas dari mulutnya, membayangkan mayatnya sendiri, jauh lebih gemuk daripada keadaannya sebenarnya, reput di kawasan setinggan. “Saya ingat bila dah mati, memang mati terus.”

30cc3ce5bf5f.en: With the door to the bathroom closed, a stranger appeared on the back of the door. Harry raised his hand to say hi, but the stranger did it at the same time. Coming closer to compensate for his blurry eyes, Harry confirmed it was just a polished steel mirror pinned reflecting his own body. Touching his gut, he saw himself doing the same in the mirror. When did I lose weight, and become this hairy?—Maybe my time in the slums? But how did I end up there? Didn’t I work like—wait? Where did I work?
30cc3ce5bf5f.t: Dengan pintu bilik mandi tertutup, seorang asing muncul di belakang pintu. Harry mengangkat tangannya untuk menyapa, tetapi orang asing itu melakukannya pada masa yang sama. Mendekat untuk mengimbangi matanya yang kabur, Harry mengesahkan ia hanyalah cermin keluli yang digilap, dipasang memantulkan tubuhnya sendiri. Menyentuh perutnya, dia melihat dirinya melakukan perkara yang sama dalam cermin. Bila aku turun berat, dan jadi berbulu macam ni?—Mungkin masa aku kat setinggan? Tapi macam mana aku boleh sampai ke sana? Bukan ke aku kerja macam—kejap? Kat mana aku kerja?

32744be95a13.en: “Huh?” He slowly revealed his face, easing them into the noises and sights from the world; the sounds of a brisling city now sounded like a symphony of normalcy: People talking and laughing, animals trotting, birds chirping, and even sounds of something hard steadily hitting wood not too far away.
32744be95a13.t: “Hah?” Dia perlahan-lahan mendedahkan wajahnya, membiasakan diri dengan bunyi dan pemandangan dunia; bunyi kota yang sibuk kini kedengaran seperti simfoni kehidupan biasa: orang bercakap dan ketawa, haiwan berlari anak, burung berkicau, malah bunyi sesuatu yang keras memukul kayu dengan tetap tidak jauh dari situ.

3365a396fef0.en: “Aww shit. I forgot about that.” The towering man scratched his short hair, turning to the stranger “So—got anything in mind?”
3365a396fef0.t: “Alamak, sial. Aku lupa pasal tu.” Lelaki tinggi itu menggaru rambut pendeknya, berpaling kepada orang asing itu “Jadi—ada apa-apa dalam fikiran?”

33cce9408b5f.en: “Wow!” Harry, mouth-opened, saw pure magic happen in front of his eyes. “That’s amazing!”
33cce9408b5f.t: “Wow!” Harry, ternganga, melihat sihir tulen berlaku di depan matanya. “Hebatnya!”

33ff62312909.en: Closing her eyes, Neferteri softly shook her head.

34f656de70a1.en: “You’re welcome, Sir Harry. Please take your time. Dinner will be served at Monnalow.” Sora, with a curtsy posy, pulled on the sides of her black skirt, getting ready to leave.
34f656de70a1.t: “Sama-sama, Tuan Harry. Silakan ambil masa. Makan malam akan dihidangkan pada Monnalow.” Sora, dengan gaya hormat menunduk, menarik sisi skirt hitamnya, bersedia untuk pergi.

35873ced47ed.en: With squinting eyes, the stranger looked from person to person, trying to recognize them, but it was to no avail; they looked like strangers to him, too. That is until his eyes crossed paths with a beautiful girl in long violet hair that sparkled in the sun. He had never seen her before, but he now wanted to see her more. With an interested smile, the stranger wanted to take a step closer to really see her beautiful pinkish, or maybe purplish eyes, but his feet were planted firmly on the ground; too shy to move. At least he could see a bit of how her skin looked spotless and radiant, and even her demeanor, too! She looked away from him, holding back her tensed up posture, clutching her elbows tightly against herself, forcing a neutral face, only to start playing with her hair as the stranger kept staring on.
35873ced47ed.t: Dengan mata mengecil, orang asing itu memandang dari seorang ke seorang, cuba mengecam mereka, tetapi sia-sia; mereka juga kelihatan seperti orang asing baginya. Sehinggalah matanya bertembung dengan seorang gadis cantik berambut ungu panjang yang berkilau di bawah matahari. Dia tidak pernah melihatnya sebelum ini, tetapi kini dia mahu melihatnya lebih lagi. Dengan senyuman berminat, orang asing itu mahu melangkah lebih dekat untuk benar-benar melihat matanya yang cantik, merah jambu, atau mungkin keunguan, tetapi kakinya tertanam kukuh di tanah; terlalu malu untuk bergerak. Sekurang-kurangnya dia dapat melihat sedikit betapa kulitnya bersih tanpa cela dan berseri, malah gayanya juga! Gadis itu mengalihkan pandangan darinya, menahan postur tubuhnya yang tegang, memegang sikunya rapat ke badan, memaksa wajah selamba, hanya untuk mula bermain dengan rambutnya ketika orang asing itu terus merenung.

37bd531f821d.en: Meanwhile, Neferteri was gritting her teeth, at least for a bit before holding back her emotions when the stranger noticed an aura of unspoken anger coming from her—like the warmth irradiating from a fire. Meanwhile, Eori was keeping her distance, and mostly to herself by appearing to now enjoy the large clouds forming in the distance—apparently just biding time.
37bd531f821d.t: Sementara itu, Neferteri mengetap gigi, sekurang-kurangnya seketika sebelum menahan emosinya apabila orang asing itu perasan aura kemarahan terpendam yang terpancar daripadanya—seperti haba yang terpancar dari api. Sementara itu, Eori menjaga jaraknya, dan kebanyakannya menyendiri dengan kelihatan kini menikmati awan-awan besar yang terbentuk di kejauhan—nampaknya sekadar membuang masa.

3837b28637dc.en: Sora, quickly fumbling her fingers as if she was making gang signs, grew red as a tomato. “I don’t think I am, but—but thank you for your words, King.”
3837b28637dc.t: Sora, cepat-cepat menggerak-gerakkan jarinya seolah-olah membuat isyarat geng, menjadi merah seperti tomato. “Saya rasa tak, tapi—tapi terima kasih atas kata-kata Tuanku.”

39bad48eb157.en: The pupils of his eyes adjusted themselves to the light in the room, allowing him to see a textured white, but blurry white ceiling. Slowly sitting up, his stiff body cracked all over, sounding like someone just popped a roll of bubble wrap. With a huge yawn, he involuntarily stretched himself, causing additional cracks, with one on his neck sounding like someone just snapped it. A constrained, nearly orgasmic, grunt came out of the stranger, feeling his tensed up muscles relaxing, like oiling up an old machinery.
39bad48eb157.t: Anak matanya menyesuaikan diri dengan cahaya dalam bilik itu, membolehkannya melihat siling putih bertekstur, tetapi kabur. Perlahan-lahan duduk, tubuhnya yang kaku berderak di merata tempat, kedengaran seperti seseorang baru memecahkan segulung pembalut buih. Dengan kuapan besar, dia meregangkan badan tanpa sengaja, menyebabkan lebih banyak bunyi derak, dengan satu di lehernya kedengaran seperti seseorang baru mematahkannya. Satu rengusan yang tertahan, hampir penuh nikmat, keluar daripada orang asing itu, merasakan ototnya yang tegang mengendur, seperti meminyakkan jentera lama.

3f41597ee93d.en: With the intensity of the toothpaste dying down, a perfect amount of refreshing citrusy mixed with herbal tea remained in his mouth. All right. Tastes nice if it is just a bit—I guess. Gonna have to watch out for everything I think I know. Harry let out a deep breath, shoving the slightly wet toothbrush into the drawer, closing it, and making his way to the bathtub. He approached it with a growing suspicion, and slowly stuck his finger inside, waiting for perhaps what could be nearly boiling hot water to melt his finger away. Instead, the water had the right degree of warmth. Hmmmm. At least that feels normal. He took off his boxers in a fell swoop, slowly submersed one foot in, then stepped around to ensure it was an actual bathtub before immersing the rest of his corpulent body in, and letting it soak up the warmth.
3f41597ee93d.t: Dengan keamatan ubat gigi itu semakin reda, rasa sitrus yang menyegarkan bercampur teh herba dalam kadar yang sempurna kekal di mulutnya. Okey. Sedap kalau sikit je—rasanya. Kena hati-hati dengan semua benda yang aku ingat aku tahu. Harry menghembus nafas panjang, menyumbat berus gigi yang agak basah itu ke dalam laci, menutupnya, dan menuju ke tab mandi. Dia mendekatinya dengan rasa curiga yang semakin bertambah, dan perlahan-lahan mencelupkan jarinya ke dalam, menunggu air yang mungkin hampir mendidih mencairkan jarinya. Sebaliknya, air itu mempunyai kehangatan yang betul. Hmmmm. Sekurang-kurangnya yang ni rasa normal. Dia menanggalkan seluar dalamnya dengan sekali rentap, perlahan-lahan merendam sebelah kaki, kemudian melangkah ke sana sini untuk memastikan ia benar-benar tab mandi sebelum merendam baki tubuhnya yang gempal, dan membiarkannya menyerap kehangatan.

4154051c8b34.en: “You okay there, bud?” Itagiba’s eyes grew concerned. He put his hand on Harry’s sweaty, stinky back, and pushed him forward. “C’mon! You can do it!”
4154051c8b34.t: “Kau okey ke tu, bro?” Mata Itagiba menjadi risau. Dia meletakkan tangannya di belakang Harry yang berpeluh dan busuk, dan menolaknya ke depan. “Ayuh! Kau boleh!”

42aab3a3ce78.en: Chapter II subchapter 4: split panel of a cheerful red-haired maid waving on a staircase and Harry nervous beside a dark-haired man.
42aab3a3ce78.t: Bab II subbab 4: panel terbelah seorang pembantu rumah berambut merah yang ceria melambai di tangga dan Harry yang gugup di sebelah lelaki berambut gelap.

49db26687570.en: “What else?” The towering man’s tone grew even blunter as his eyes were keen on the stranger’s expression.
49db26687570.t: “Apa lagi?” Nada lelaki tinggi itu menjadi lebih tumpul sementara matanya tajam memerhati riak wajah orang asing itu.

4aad84564a7c.en: “Fanbiro! C’mon!” Before Neferteri could even finish, Nina had already pulled the feathers of her goth bird, performing an exit maneuver with her mount.
4aad84564a7c.t: “Fanbiro! Jom!” Sebelum Neferteri sempat menghabiskan kata-katanya, Nina sudah menarik bulu burung goth-nya, melakukan gerakan melarikan diri dengan tunggangannya.

4babe20c3ea7.en: Neferteri continued, “—and this lovely purple-haired-lady is the third princess Eori—”
4babe20c3ea7.t: Neferteri menyambung, “—dan wanita berambut ungu yang jelita ini ialah puteri ketiga Eori—”

4cd44ffb4c05.en: The stranger chuckled as he saw Nina, with her hair flying up in the air, wildly giggling, and her trusted mount, leaving black feathers behind as they both ran towards the back of the castle, vanishing from sight.
4cd44ffb4c05.t: Orang asing itu tergelak kecil melihat Nina, dengan rambutnya berterbangan, mengekek liar, dan tunggangan setianya, meninggalkan bulu-bulu hitam ketika mereka berdua berlari ke belakang istana, hilang dari pandangan.

50fe6063685f.en: Moving his attention to the rails of the upward spiraling stairs, Harry saw a small glimpse of a blurry image, of which his brain had just enough imagination to fill in the gap: yellow underwear with white embroidery belonging to the cutesy small legs of the fiery-red-haired maid.
50fe6063685f.t: Mengalihkan perhatiannya ke pagar tangga berpusar yang naik ke atas, Harry nampak sekilas imej yang kabur, yang cukup untuk otaknya mengisi kekosongan dengan imaginasi: seluar dalam kuning bersulam putih milik kaki kecil yang comel pembantu rumah berambut merah menyala itu.

54b46287720e.en: The child in pink pointed her tiny finger at the stranger. “MOM! He looks like Uncle Alford!” Her eyes shone in delight seeing someone familiar. “Even his belly, too!”
54b46287720e.t: Kanak-kanak berbaju merah jambu itu menunjuk jari kecilnya ke arah orang asing itu. “MAMA! Dia macam Pak Cik Alford!” Matanya bersinar gembira melihat seseorang yang dikenali. “Perut dia pun sama!”

55de836ce525.en: Chapter II subchapter 5: a red-haired maid holds out a round colored dial toward a seated man in a room with a bathtub.
55de836ce525.t: Bab II subbab 5: seorang pembantu rumah berambut merah menghulurkan dail bulat berwarna-warni kepada seorang lelaki yang duduk di bilik bertab mandi.

57817b8b5dfd.en: His ears heard the usual sounds of a busy city, but somehow it felt amplified, as if they were screaming in his ears, obnoxiously loud. A soothing, slightly chill wind blew through the room, but he shivered as if someone just poured a bucket of icy water over him.
57817b8b5dfd.t: Telinganya mendengar bunyi biasa sebuah kota yang sibuk, tetapi entah bagaimana ia terasa diperkuat, seolah-olah mereka menjerit di telinganya, bising yang menjengkelkan. Angin yang menenangkan dan sedikit dingin bertiup melalui bilik itu, tetapi dia menggigil seolah-olah seseorang baru menyimbah sebaldi air ais ke atasnya.

581212151e4d.en: “Like—a part of a day? Twenty-four hours?” Harry showed the color swatch that somehow told the time to Sora, pointing at the lighted section. “Like wouldn't this be ten—ahhh.” Harry’s hands froze in the air like a mime. His mind clearly felt like there was something that came after ten, but it just wouldn’t come out. Ten hours? No—? Harry scratched his beard.
581212151e4d.t: “Macam—satu bahagian hari? Dua puluh empat jam?” Harry menunjukkan contoh warna yang entah bagaimana memberitahu masa itu kepada Sora, menunjuk ke bahagian yang menyala. “Macam bukan ke ni pukul sepuluh—ahhh.” Tangan Harry membeku di udara seperti pelakon mim. Fikirannya jelas merasakan ada sesuatu yang datang selepas sepuluh, tetapi ia tidak mahu keluar. Sepuluh jam? Bukan—? Harry menggaru janggutnya.

586702c83837.en: “All right, Harry. What do you want for dinner?” Itagiba cracked his neck as he kept walking, passing by the middle tower.
586702c83837.t: “Okey, Harry. Kau nak makan apa malam ni?” Itagiba meletupkan lehernya sambil terus berjalan, melintasi menara tengah.

5a1a1711bbfb.en: In the corridor, the wheelbarrow exuded a familiar odd smell. Taking a sniff of the air around him, the stranger’s mind clicked as to what it was. That smells just like the room I was in! Was I brought in then? He peeked at the wooden tiles in the ground and noticed the same faint bloodied footprints passing both ways in the corridor. Looking up, he saw the same glass, but this time metal instead of wood jars with whitish stones inside. That has to be a lamp, right?
5a1a1711bbfb.t: Di koridor, kereta sorong itu mengeluarkan bau aneh yang biasa. Menghidu udara di sekelilingnya, fikiran orang asing itu dapat menangkap apa bau itu. Bau ni sama macam bilik aku tadi! Jadi aku dibawa masuk guna ni ke? Dia mengintai jubin kayu di lantai dan perasan kesan tapak kaki berdarah samar yang sama melalui kedua-dua arah di koridor. Mendongak, dia nampak kaca yang sama, tetapi kali ini balang logam dan bukannya kayu dengan batu keputihan di dalamnya. Itu mesti lampu, kan?

5a232622985a.en: Sora’s hand reached out to an apparent danger. “Please watch out for the glass or you might hurt your hand.”
5a232622985a.t: Tangan Sora terhulur ke arah bahaya yang jelas. “Tolong berhati-hati dengan kaca itu nanti tangan tuan cedera.”

611c5b346ae6.en: “Yeah. That. Do you know what that is?” Itagiba glanced at her.
611c5b346ae6.t: “Ha. Tu. Kau tahu benda tu apa?” Itagiba mengerlingnya.

61309207dd41.en: Meanwhile Sora’s eyes grew watery from the Bagarisa musk burning up her sensitive nose. Sounding as if she was stuffed, she tried to not breathe from her nose as she spoke up “Sir—is there anything else you need?”
61309207dd41.t: Sementara itu, mata Sora berair kerana kasturi Bagarisa membakar hidungnya yang sensitif. Kedengaran seperti hidung tersumbat, dia cuba tidak bernafas melalui hidung ketika bersuara “Tuan—ada apa-apa lagi yang tuan perlukan?”

617dd286fde2.en: “So, what else other than eating tacos and watching—what was it again?” Itagiba, the towering king, looked firmly back at the stranger.
617dd286fde2.t: “Jadi, apa lagi selain makan taco dan tengok—apa tadi?” Itagiba, raja yang tinggi lampai itu, memandang tegas orang asing itu.

61bef16f8fc9.en: Eating the taco with the same voracity as the previous one, he then gulped down a large glass filled with Vienna lager like a camel. Putting the glass aside, he was ready to send in another taco when he paused his grubby hands, using it to bend his body to the right instead. His face contorted, and reddened—like a baby trying to poop. His butt cheeks, now spread out apart, gave way for a sudden gust of stench air to blow through, sounding like someone trying to whistle for the first time in their life.
61bef16f8fc9.t: Memakan taco itu dengan kerakusan yang sama seperti tadi, dia kemudian meneguk segelas besar lager Vienna seperti unta. Meletakkan gelas itu ke tepi, dia sudah bersedia menyumbat satu lagi taco apabila dia menghentikan tangannya yang comot, sebaliknya menggunakannya untuk membengkokkan badan ke kanan. Wajahnya berkerut dan memerah—seperti bayi cuba berak. Dua belah punggungnya, kini terkuak, memberi laluan kepada hembusan udara busuk yang tiba-tiba, kedengaran seperti seseorang yang cuba bersiul buat pertama kali dalam hidupnya.

62095e81f0e7.en: “I—I saw them disappear, and then I was left—alone. That’s it. Well, I remember everything being dark too—I thought it was my living room, but maybe it was a dream? I think?” The stranger’s eyes wandered away; he went silent as the crippling darkness began crawling back to his mind the further he pushed it to remember what happened.
62095e81f0e7.t: “S—saya nampak mereka hilang, lepas tu saya ditinggalkan—seorang diri. Itu saja. Oh, saya ingat semuanya gelap juga—saya ingat itu ruang tamu saya, tapi mungkin mimpi? Rasanya?” Mata orang asing itu melilau; dia terdiam ketika kegelapan yang melumpuhkan mula merangkak kembali ke fikirannya semakin dia memaksa diri mengingati apa yang berlaku.

625dec64291c.en: “I—guess I can try. I never made them before though—” Harry and Itagiba entered the main floor of the Southeast tower—the tower opposite the one he had woken up in. The main floor was wildly different; no longer a witch’s wet dream, but rather a large living room of sorts with couches, stuff for painting, books, and glass jars that looked like lamps, but with whitish, pearly stones inside them that sparkled in the sunlight of the open window—kinda similar to the other ones he had seen in the other tower. In the nearby ground, drawings, with an awful lot of pink, littered the floor as if a tornado had passed through.
625dec64291c.t: “Sa—saya cuba. Tapi saya tak pernah buat sebelum ni—” Harry dan Itagiba memasuki tingkat utama menara Tenggara—menara yang bertentangan dengan menara tempat dia tersedar. Tingkat utama itu sangat berbeza; tidak lagi impian basah ahli sihir, sebaliknya semacam ruang tamu besar dengan sofa, barang-barang untuk melukis, buku, dan balang kaca yang kelihatan seperti lampu, tetapi dengan batu keputihan seperti mutiara di dalamnya yang berkilauan di bawah cahaya matahari dari tingkap yang terbuka—agak serupa dengan yang dia nampak di menara lain. Di lantai berdekatan, lukisan-lukisan, dengan warna merah jambu yang amat banyak, bersepah di lantai seolah-olah puting beliung baru melanda.

63bcf9dd7f0f.en: Harry, passing by the south tower, walking towards the southeast one, instantly remembered one thing only. “Hah—tacos?”
63bcf9dd7f0f.t: Harry, melintasi menara selatan, berjalan menuju ke menara tenggara, serta-merta teringat satu perkara sahaja. “Hah—taco?”

64644be325e7.en: Feeling a squeeze on his breath, and a sinking heart, the stranger took one last glance at the cute girl in purple—feeling like she had already dumped him before he even had the chance to say hi. Turning his attention to the unwavering will coming from this tall man, he felt like he had no choice but to shake his hand. As their hands met, the stranger imagined his hand being crushed by his tight grip, but instead the handshake itself felt rather welcoming; his own slightly cold hands, and weaker grip, were met with a firm, supportive handshake. “Ah—sorry—ahhh—but I don’t know.” Muttering words came out amidst hums from the stranger, looking up to the red, fiery, but somehow natural-looking eyes of this tall man.
64644be325e7.t: Merasakan nafasnya tersekat dan jantungnya tenggelam, orang asing itu mengerling buat kali terakhir gadis comel berbaju ungu itu—terasa seolah-olah gadis itu sudah memutuskan hubungan dengannya sebelum dia sempat menyapa. Mengalihkan perhatiannya kepada tekad tidak berganjak lelaki tinggi ini, dia merasa tiada pilihan selain bersalam dengannya. Ketika tangan mereka bertemu, orang asing itu membayangkan tangannya dihancurkan oleh genggaman kuat itu, tetapi sebaliknya salam itu terasa agak mesra; tangannya sendiri yang agak sejuk, dan genggamannya yang lemah, disambut oleh salam yang teguh dan menyokong. “Ah—maaf—ahhh—tapi saya tak tahu.” Kata-kata berbisik keluar di celah dengungan orang asing itu, mendongak memandang mata merah lelaki tinggi itu yang berapi-api, tetapi entah bagaimana kelihatan semula jadi.

650c890e8eed.en: Quickly bowing, Sora replied in her usual rap freestyle fashion—at least in terms of speed. “Yes, King! I will do it immediately!” The maid then took off upstairs in a rush as if her life depended on it.
650c890e8eed.t: Tunduk dengan pantas, Sora menjawab dengan gaya rap bebasnya yang biasa—sekurang-kurangnya dari segi kelajuan. “Baik, Tuanku! Saya akan buat segera!” Pembantu rumah itu kemudian bergegas naik ke atas seolah-olah nyawanya bergantung padanya.

66cf3aab4584.en: Harry, realizing where his mind was at, let go of her nearly-violated hand. “Thank you—ah—Sora.” His hands and imagination still wanted to play with it some more, but then he remembered the words Marry a princess. Paying close attention to her humanoid figure as she stepped back, he then noticed her ears were pretty different from what a normal ear was; hers had a pointy shape, like an elf’s, but it flopped inward like certain dog breeds. Touching his own ear, Harry felt the normal roundness instead.
66cf3aab4584.t: Harry, menyedari ke mana fikirannya melayang, melepaskan tangan gadis itu yang hampir dicabul. “Terima kasih—ah—Sora.” Tangan dan imaginasinya masih mahu bermain dengannya lagi, tetapi kemudian dia teringat kata-kata Kahwin dengan seorang puteri. Memerhati dengan teliti susuk tubuhnya ketika dia berundur, dia kemudian perasan telinganya agak berbeza daripada telinga biasa; telinganya berbentuk tajam, seperti telinga bunian, tetapi terkulai ke dalam seperti baka anjing tertentu. Menyentuh telinganya sendiri, Harry merasakan bentuk bulat yang biasa.

675b68d03ec2.en: A small chuckle came out of Itagiba. “Pfff—you sure? That’s kind of lame, you know? We can give you a better name.”
675b68d03ec2.t: Satu ketawa kecil keluar daripada Itagiba. “Pfff—kau pasti? Itu macam tak best, tahu tak? Kami boleh bagi kau nama yang lebih bagus.”

68292393253f.en: “I’m sorry, sir, but what is an hour?” Sora’s ear perked up, trying to listen to Harry as clearly as she could.
68292393253f.t: “Maaf, tuan, tapi apa itu jam?” Telinga Sora tegak, cuba mendengar Harry sejelas mungkin.

69ecb9b97d9a.en: “Nina Sanbi Royal!” Neferteri, the only one not laughing, called out to her in the same vibe that a Latino mother would right before taking out one of her sandals and performing a headshot with it. However, she did not reach out for hers, or whatever else she wore under her long blue dress. Rather, she remained calm, at least in how she composed herself.
69ecb9b97d9a.t: “Nina Sanbi Royal!” Neferteri, satu-satunya yang tidak ketawa, memanggilnya dengan aura yang sama seperti seorang ibu Latin sebelum menanggalkan sebelah seliparnya dan membuat tembakan tepat ke kepala dengannya. Namun, dia tidak mencapai seliparnya, atau apa sahaja yang dipakainya di bawah gaun biru panjangnya. Sebaliknya, dia kekal tenang, sekurang-kurangnya dari segi cara dia mengawal dirinya.

69fa0a254c16.en: “I’m sorry—but what is Monnalow?” Harry held his face as if was about to be told that’s enough.
69fa0a254c16.t: “Maaf—tapi apa itu Monnalow?” Harry memegang wajahnya seolah-olah hendak diberitahu cukuplah tu.

6a265c8fd422.en: Nina bowed before making her way back into the castle, savoring the victory of her newly struck deal.
6a265c8fd422.t: Nina tunduk hormat sebelum kembali ke dalam istana, menikmati kemenangan perjanjian barunya.

6a2c1e9650a1.en: Harry went to take a step to follow her, but the king gripped his arm again, holding him in place.
6a2c1e9650a1.t: Harry hendak melangkah mengikutinya, tetapi raja mencengkam lengannya lagi, menahannya di tempatnya.

6c9c427ec7fa.en: Spitting some of the syrup into the sink, he then pulled on the handle attached to the pipe to let the water flow. Sticking his mouth into the pseudo waterfall, a refreshing taste came through, only to then turn into as if he was swallowing cold water from a freezing lake. Coughing his lungs out, while trying to breathe through the pain, he agonized, trying to use the toothbrush to scrape off this powerful concoction of his tongue.
6c9c427ec7fa.t: Meludahkan sebahagian sirap ke dalam sinki, dia kemudian menarik pemegang yang dipasang pada paip untuk membiarkan air mengalir. Menyuakan mulutnya ke dalam air terjun palsu itu, rasa menyegarkan datang, hanya untuk bertukar seolah-olah dia menelan air sejuk dari tasik yang membeku. Terbatuk-batuk teruk, sambil cuba bernafas menahan kesakitan, dia terseksa, cuba menggunakan berus gigi itu untuk mengikis campuran yang kuat itu dari lidahnya.

6d693f8cfd73.en: On the right, bookshelves were filled with all kinds of books in different shapes and colors, with some looking so old that they would probably curse you or fall apart into dust the moment you opened it—truly the kind of gift to someone with rhinitis. But the books were not the only thing decorating the right side of the room; weirdly shaped two-finger rings, that looked like what a flashy rapper would wear, decorated a section of the wall. In front of that was a table with grinders dirty with blue dust and boxes in a familiar green wood color that contained blue stones and blue dust. At the base of the table, a large, raw, unpainted wood crate was filled with used diamond-like colored stones, looking pretty close to what the stranger had seen back in the room he woke up in.
6d693f8cfd73.t: Di sebelah kanan, rak buku dipenuhi pelbagai jenis buku dalam pelbagai bentuk dan warna, dengan sesetengahnya kelihatan begitu lama sehingga ia mungkin akan menyumpah kau atau hancur menjadi debu sebaik sahaja dibuka—benar-benar hadiah yang sesuai untuk penghidap resdung. Tetapi buku bukan satu-satunya benda yang menghiasi bahagian kanan bilik; cincin dua jari yang berbentuk pelik, yang kelihatan seperti yang dipakai oleh penyanyi rap yang suka menunjuk-nunjuk, menghiasi satu bahagian dinding. Di hadapannya ada meja dengan pengisar yang kotor dengan debu biru dan kotak-kotak berwarna kayu hijau yang biasa berisi batu biru dan debu biru. Di kaki meja, sebuah peti kayu mentah besar yang tidak dicat dipenuhi batu berwarna seperti berlian yang terpakai, kelihatan hampir sama dengan apa yang orang asing itu nampak di bilik tempat dia tersedar tadi.

6dd9428a4446.en: Weird. The stranger took his time walking to the door, looking at how foreign everything looked.
6dd9428a4446.t: Peliknya. Orang asing itu mengambil masanya berjalan ke pintu, memerhati betapa asingnya segala-galanya.

6e799b14cb87.en: Feeling like she dumped him a second time, the stranger could not think of anything to say, instead an ass-licking smile appeared on him as he looked at his own self, realizing he was in the wrong, making the bubbly feeling inside him fizzle out like a soda left open in the fridge.
6e799b14cb87.t: Terasa seperti gadis itu memutuskannya buat kali kedua, orang asing itu tidak dapat memikirkan apa-apa untuk dikatakan, sebaliknya senyuman bodek muncul di wajahnya sambil dia memandang dirinya sendiri, menyedari dia yang bersalah, membuatkan perasaan berbuih dalam dirinya mendesis hilang seperti air soda yang dibiarkan terbuka dalam peti sejuk.

6f5513a8bdbf.en: “—I don’t remember much, but—Oh! The—doggo! I can’t remember his name either, but he was black and white. We were watching TV while he begged for food—he disappeared. Then—so did my parents. I, somehow, felt old and fat after that—lonely too.” The stranger’s voice tapered at the end. He looked at the ground, feeling an urge rising within him to cry out the darkness gripping his heart, but seeing the cute girl in purple glance at him, he held the tears back with all of the emotional strength that he could muster.
6f5513a8bdbf.t: “—Saya tak ingat banyak, tapi—Oh! Anjing—tu! Saya tak ingat nama dia juga, tapi dia hitam putih. Kami tengah tengok TV sementara dia minta makanan—dia hilang. Lepas tu—ibu bapa saya pun hilang. Saya, entah macam mana, rasa tua dan gemuk lepas tu—sunyi juga.” Suara orang asing itu semakin perlahan di hujung. Dia memandang tanah, merasakan desakan yang meningkat dalam dirinya untuk menangiskan kegelapan yang mencengkam jantungnya, tetapi melihat gadis comel berbaju ungu itu mengerlingnya, dia menahan air mata dengan sepenuh kekuatan emosi yang mampu dikumpulnya.

704fe5c4c983.en: Neferteri, seeming to realize the misunderstanding, spoke after. “The princess in question is our second princess, Maiara. Upon hearing the news, she decided to assist our courtroom scientist, Gabiro, and fell heart-struck once she saw you being resurrected.”
704fe5c4c983.t: Neferteri, nampaknya menyedari salah faham itu, bercakap selepas itu. “Puteri yang dimaksudkan ialah puteri kedua kami, Maiara. Apabila mendengar berita itu, dia memutuskan untuk membantu saintis istana kami, Gabiro, dan jatuh hati sebaik sahaja dia melihat kamu dihidupkan semula.”

70712fd6a5b0.en: An eagerly energetic voice came from the child in pink. “Nina! The four-h, and best princess! With her tru-ted mount, Fanbiro!”
70712fd6a5b0.t: Suara yang bersemangat datang dari kanak-kanak berbaju merah jambu itu. “Nina! Puteri keempa, dan paling baik! Dengan tunggangan yang dipecayai, Fanbiro!”

7225d712fa4b.en: Harry followed suit. As he got half-way into the room, he saw a two-person table with its top partly carved, looking like a three-dimensional painted wooden battlefield of sorts, containing clusters of statues on top, each forming battalions of humanoids, animals, or even monsters. By the stairs, he saw a bookcase that was filled with stuff other than books: additional figures, statues, balls of different shapes, and even additional boards that looked like pieces of battlefield. His mind suddenly clicked on a spoken foreign name. “Sorry, who’s Eiri?”
7225d712fa4b.t: Harry mengikut. Ketika dia sampai separuh bilik, dia nampak sebuah meja dua orang dengan permukaannya diukir sebahagian, kelihatan seperti semacam medan perang kayu bercat tiga dimensi, berisi kelompok patung di atasnya, setiap satu membentuk batalion manusia, haiwan, malah raksasa. Di tepi tangga, dia nampak sebuah rak buku yang dipenuhi barang selain buku: patung-patung tambahan, arca, bola pelbagai bentuk, malah papan-papan tambahan yang kelihatan seperti kepingan medan perang. Fikirannya tiba-tiba tersangkut pada satu nama asing yang disebut. “Maaf, siapa Eiri?”

74f6e7c4b3c4.en: “Yes, sir,” Sora hid her hands behind her back. “Do you need an explanation of the room?”
74f6e7c4b3c4.t: “Ya, tuan,” Sora menyembunyikan tangannya di belakang. “Tuan perlukan penerangan tentang bilik ini?”

76250625c766.en: Turning his attention to the broken window, he carefully peaked his head through and saw a sprawling city as far as the eyes could see. At least it looked like one, as it was a blurry mess of boxy-shaped buildings of all kinds, with a somewhat repeating color palette of white with bluish or brownish roofs that seemed to be on fire. Actually, the entire city seemed on fire. Is that fire? Wait. No. That’s a chimney! A wind blew through, bringing the smell of pastry, smoked meat, and fish. The stranger looked at the people past a grayish wall of some kind, and saw blurry humanoid figures in the distance that did not seem to be in any rush, at least most of them. Well, except a pink and white eye-catching humanoid running by herself, zig-zagging through the populace appearing to hold something.
76250625c766.t: Mengalihkan perhatiannya kepada tingkap yang pecah, dia menjengukkan kepalanya dengan berhati-hati dan ternampak sebuah kota luas sejauh mata memandang. Sekurang-kurangnya ia kelihatan begitu, kerana ia hanyalah kekacauan kabur bangunan berbentuk kotak pelbagai jenis, dengan palet warna yang agak berulang, iaitu putih dengan bumbung kebiruan atau keperangan yang kelihatan seperti terbakar. Sebenarnya, seluruh kota itu kelihatan terbakar. Itu api ke? Kejap. Bukan. Itu cerobong! Angin bertiup, membawa bau pastri, daging salai dan ikan. Orang asing itu memandang orang ramai di sebalik sejenis tembok kelabu, dan nampak susuk-susuk manusia yang kabur di kejauhan yang tidak kelihatan tergesa-gesa, sekurang-kurangnya kebanyakannya. Kecuali satu susuk manusia merah jambu dan putih yang menarik perhatian, berlari seorang diri, berzig-zag di celah orang ramai dan kelihatan memegang sesuatu.

7684de106b64.en: What appeared to be mere seconds later, a familiar pink humanoid, but no longer with her trusted mount, busted the doors open on the second floor. She jumped, leaning herself against the rails of the balcony, and screamed back “WHAT DADDY?”
7684de106b64.t: Seakan-akan hanya beberapa saat kemudian, susuk manusia merah jambu yang dikenali, tetapi tidak lagi bersama tunggangan setianya, merempuh pintu terbuka di tingkat dua. Dia melompat, menyandarkan dirinya pada pagar balkoni, dan menjerit balas “APA PAPA?”

76c4b29d60d2.en: A heavy man, whose body shape would definitely require a seat for each buttock if he were to try to ride a train, sat in a red recliner that molded to his body…
76c4b29d60d2.t: Seorang lelaki gempal, yang bentuk badannya pasti memerlukan satu tempat duduk untuk setiap belah punggung jika dia cuba menaiki kereta api, duduk di atas kerusi malas merah yang mengikut bentuk tubuhnya…

7958640f6b22.en: “King’s—maid?” A few steps in, and Harry was already out of breath.
7958640f6b22.t: “Pembantu—Raja?” Beberapa langkah naik, dan Harry sudah termengah-mengah.

79731df6d7c5.en: “Huh? Really?” Itagiba exchanged a quick glare with Neferteri.
79731df6d7c5.t: “Hah? Ye ke?” Itagiba bertukar jelingan pantas dengan Neferteri.

7a862c03974c.en: After moving her fingers around, and speaking under her breath unintelligibly, Nina shouted back “ELEVEN!”
7a862c03974c.t: Selepas menggerak-gerakkan jarinya, dan bercakap perlahan-lahan dengan tidak jelas, Nina menjerit balas “SEBELAS!”

7be1839b59d1.en: Itagiba shook his head up-down with a nice self-important smile, pointing at himself with his own right thumb as if he was a political candidate posing for a poster.
7be1839b59d1.t: Itagiba mengangguk-angguk dengan senyuman bangga diri, menunjuk ke arah dirinya dengan ibu jari kanannya seolah-olah dia calon politik yang bergaya untuk poster.

7cf79571fb8b.en: Is that blood? He noticed the red stains on the wall meeting a pool of darker red liquid down on the floor. His thighs were still tensed up and sore, so he used his left hand on the bookshelf, and crouched down towards it like an old person—grunting like one as well. As he went down, the stranger’s nose pierced a cloud of stagnation; a rusty, slightly pungent air entered his lungs, making him nauseous. Stiffening his face, the stranger breathed out through his nose, trying to keep the odd smell at bay. “Oh, shit, it is!” He jumped back up like a skittish cat, his heart skipping a beat, and a primordial fear striking his core. His head moved around the room furiously, searching for an enemy he did not know existed. His squinting eyes quickly followed a trail of bloodied footprints from the pool near his feet that led out of the room, stepping on what appeared to be a fallen door. What should I do? What if they killed me?
7cf79571fb8b.t: Itu darah ke? Dia perasan kesan merah di dinding bertemu dengan lopak cecair merah yang lebih gelap di lantai. Pehanya masih tegang dan sengal, jadi dia menggunakan tangan kirinya pada rak buku, dan mencangkung ke arahnya seperti orang tua—merengus seperti orang tua juga. Ketika dia turun, hidung orang asing itu menembusi awan udara yang bertakung; udara berkarat yang sedikit hamis memasuki paru-parunya, membuatkannya loya. Mengeraskan wajahnya, orang asing itu menghembus nafas melalui hidung, cuba menjauhkan bau aneh itu. “Oh, sial, memang darah!” Dia melompat bangun seperti kucing yang terkejut, jantungnya terhenti sedetik, dan ketakutan purba menyentap terasnya. Kepalanya berpusing-pusing memandang sekeliling bilik, mencari musuh yang dia tidak tahu wujud. Matanya yang mengecil pantas mengekori jejak tapak kaki berdarah dari lopak berhampiran kakinya yang menuju keluar dari bilik, memijak sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti pintu yang tumbang. Apa aku patut buat? Macam mana kalau mereka bunuh aku?

7d28c8a3a422.en: Discombobulated, Harry stood there, watching the king disappear. The words “Thank you?” slipped through his mouth, followed by a bead of sweat running down his forehead, imagining himself asking her. With one slow step after the other, Harry went back to his primary goal of walking up the mountain in the shape of spiraling stairs. So I can really just ask for that? Harry imagined her small hands washing his back, exactly where an actual itch started to appear in the middle of his back, right where his hands couldn’t reach. As he reached the third floor, he saw that she was not there. The floor itself looked the exact same as the tower he got off—a small room with two doors, except this time the doors were bright blue. Stepping into the stairs going to the fourth floor, he focused on how she would look as she brushed his back—perhaps with the same embarrassment from when he touched her hands, or perhaps with a willful determination like when she ran up the stairs? But isn’t that asking too much of her? Hmm. But if the king says it’s fine, then I guess it’s fine?
7d28c8a3a422.t: Kebingungan, Harry berdiri di situ, memerhati raja itu hilang. Kata-kata “Terima kasih?” terlepas dari mulutnya, diikuti manik peluh yang mengalir di dahinya, membayangkan dirinya meminta perkara itu. Selangkah demi selangkah perlahan-lahan, Harry kembali kepada matlamat utamanya mendaki gunung berbentuk tangga berpusar itu. Jadi aku betul-betul boleh minta macam tu? Harry membayangkan tangan kecil gadis itu menggosok belakangnya, betul-betul di tempat rasa gatal sebenar mula muncul di tengah-tengah belakangnya, tepat di tempat yang tidak dapat dicapai tangannya. Ketika dia sampai di tingkat tiga, dia nampak gadis itu tiada di situ. Tingkat itu sendiri kelihatan betul-betul sama dengan menara yang dia turun tadi—sebuah bilik kecil dengan dua pintu, kecuali kali ini pintunya biru terang. Melangkah ke tangga menuju ke tingkat empat, dia menumpukan perhatian pada bagaimana rupa gadis itu ketika menggosok belakangnya—mungkin dengan rasa malu yang sama seperti ketika dia menyentuh tangannya, atau mungkin dengan keazaman yang teguh seperti ketika dia berlari menaiki tangga? Tapi bukankah itu terlalu banyak meminta daripada dia? Hmm. Tapi kalau raja kata tak apa, rasanya tak apalah?

7ea8dcb0fb6d.en: Harry bit his cheeks, looking at the odd time-keeping instrument. Maybe I am just remembering wrongly, then. With a slightly strained smile, he looked back at Sora. “Thank you for showing me all of this!”
7ea8dcb0fb6d.t: Harry menggigit pipinya, memandang alat penunjuk masa yang aneh itu. Mungkin aku cuma tersalah ingat, kalau macam tu. Dengan senyuman yang sedikit tegang, dia memandang semula Sora. “Terima kasih kerana tunjukkan semua ni!”

7f479e4c029a.en: Laughing out loud at the white bright light on the TV, the heavy man finished gulping down the beer, and with a lazy fling, he threw the bottle aside, careless to look, or bother where it would land; the bottle did not make a noise. Instead, it vanished into the darkness not soon after leaving his hands.
7f479e4c029a.t: Ketawa terbahak-bahak melihat cahaya putih terang di TV, lelaki gempal itu menghabiskan birnya, dan dengan lontaran malas, dia mencampakkan botol itu ke tepi, tidak peduli untuk melihat atau ambil tahu di mana ia mendarat; botol itu tidak berbunyi. Sebaliknya, ia lenyap ke dalam kegelapan tidak lama selepas meninggalkan tangannya.

80907259a3ce.en: As the stars disappeared from his vision, a memory appeared in the soft darkness of his vision; it was himself, seated in something comfortable, reddish in color, but he could not remember the details other than knowing it was a recliner.
80907259a3ce.t: Ketika bintang-bintang hilang dari penglihatannya, satu ingatan muncul dalam kegelapan lembut penglihatannya; dirinya sendiri, duduk di atas sesuatu yang selesa, berwarna kemerahan, tetapi dia tidak dapat mengingati butirannya selain tahu bahawa ia kerusi malas.

80e433984f15.en: “Your corpse was discovered in the slums by the guards. We were aware you would lose a few memories based on your advanced state of decay, yet it is unfortunate to hear that you lost far more than the average person would.” Neferteri spoke like a president on live TV reading from a teleprompter—rehearsed, slowly, clearly, but kinda emotionless.
80e433984f15.t: “Mayat kamu ditemui di kawasan setinggan oleh pengawal. Kami sedar kamu akan kehilangan sedikit ingatan berdasarkan tahap pereputan kamu yang teruk, namun malang sekali mendengar kamu kehilangan jauh lebih banyak daripada kebanyakan orang.” Neferteri bercakap seperti presiden di TV secara langsung yang membaca dari teleprompter—sudah dilatih, perlahan, jelas, tetapi agak tanpa emosi.

81df56355af1.en: Nina hurled herself to stand on top of the rails, and like a cheerleader, she began making weird hand signs with her hands and arms. The first was a rectangle shape above her head. She then said out loud “H!” The second transformed into a triangle shape, and then she said “A!” The third and fourth were a hand wave that went up, then down to the right in a forty-five-degree angle for a bit, then halfway back horizontally, up to the middle, then right horizontally.
81df56355af1.t: Nina melontarkan dirinya untuk berdiri di atas pagar, dan seperti seorang pemandu sorak, dia mula membuat isyarat tangan yang pelik dengan tangan dan lengannya. Yang pertama ialah bentuk segi empat tepat di atas kepalanya. Dia kemudian berkata dengan kuat “H!” Yang kedua bertukar menjadi bentuk segi tiga, dan kemudian dia berkata “A!” Yang ketiga dan keempat ialah lambaian tangan yang naik, kemudian turun ke kanan pada sudut empat puluh lima darjah seketika, kemudian separuh jalan kembali secara mendatar, naik ke tengah, kemudian ke kanan secara mendatar.

81ea1028b64a.en: “Well, what do you know?” The towering man in white cape let go of the stranger’s weak-ass grip. His question felt like a blunt weapon by the quick timing, but his intonation seemed pretty curious about it, rather than just feeling rude.
81ea1028b64a.t: “Habis tu, apa yang kau tahu?” Lelaki tinggi berjubah putih itu melepaskan genggaman lembik orang asing itu. Soalannya terasa seperti senjata tumpul kerana pantasnya, tetapi intonasinya kedengaran agak ingin tahu, bukannya terasa biadab.

865151ffe148.en: Itagiba chuckled out loudly. “Ah—ah! Oooh! That’s great! I need to use that one someday.”
865151ffe148.t: Itagiba tergelak kuat. “Ah—ah! Oooh! Bagus tu! Aku kena guna yang tu satu hari nanti.”

875fe750d7f6.en: Us? Harry’s mind searched its entire catalog of words, but nothing came up for it. Humans, yes, but not Naked Bruntos.
875fe750d7f6.t: Kita? Fikiran Harry menyelongkar seluruh katalog perkataannya, tetapi tiada apa yang muncul. Manusia, ya, tetapi bukan Naked Bruntos.

8a36816ed3ba.en: Letting out a faint exasperated sigh when the stones stopped rattling, Sora continued, bowing, “I’m sorry for my rudeness, sir Harry. This type of fost lamp is not meant to be hung, so it does not come with a cable. We do light it up for you every evening—” Noticing Harry’s puppy eyes, Sora continued. “But I can show you right now if you would like.”
8a36816ed3ba.t: Menghembus keluhan jengkel yang perlahan apabila batu-batu itu berhenti bergegar, Sora menyambung, sambil menunduk, “Saya minta maaf atas kebiadaban saya, Tuan Harry. Lampu fost jenis ini tidak bertujuan untuk digantung, jadi ia tidak datang dengan kabel. Kami memang menyalakannya untuk tuan setiap petang—” Perasan mata anak anjing Harry, Sora menyambung. “Tapi saya boleh tunjukkan sekarang jika tuan mahu.”

8b28647be40e.en: “Hey! Come on down!” A friendly voice caught his attention amongst the rustles of the city’s noises. Following the source of the voice, he saw the walls with a beautiful splash of flowery colors hugging its insides, separating the city from a green field with a large boxy castle in the middle. Right below him, he saw a patch of what looked like a splash of blood contrasting the beautiful green, with three adult humanoids in blue and golden hues standing around it. Meanwhile, zooming randomly around like a headless chicken, a small pink humanoid on top of a large, round black thing rushed by the purple-hair humanoid, nearly crashing against it. He could not make any details of what was happening, but he clearly heard the echo of a child's laughter, shrieks of a distressed bird, and a girly, somewhat angry, voice that screamed back “CUT IT OUT, NINA!”
8b28647be40e.t: “Hei! Turunlah!” Satu suara mesra menarik perhatiannya di tengah-tengah riuh-rendah bunyi kota. Mengikut arah suara itu, dia nampak tembok-tembok dengan percikan warna bunga yang indah memeluk bahagian dalamnya, memisahkan kota daripada padang hijau dengan istana besar berbentuk kotak di tengahnya. Betul-betul di bawahnya, dia nampak sepetak sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti percikan darah yang kontras dengan hijau yang indah, dengan tiga susuk manusia dewasa berwarna biru dan keemasan berdiri di sekelilingnya. Sementara itu, meluncur secara rawak seperti ayam tanpa kepala, satu susuk manusia kecil merah jambu di atas benda hitam besar yang bulat melintas laju di sebelah susuk manusia berambut ungu, hampir merempuhnya. Dia tidak dapat melihat butiran apa yang sedang berlaku, tetapi dia jelas mendengar gema ketawa seorang kanak-kanak, jeritan seekor burung yang tertekan, dan suara gadis yang agak marah menjerit balas “HENTIKAN, NINA!”

8c804f29fad3.en: A sudden gleam appeared in the stranger’s eyes, focusing as much attention as he could muster to hear what Neferteri was about to say.
8c804f29fad3.t: Satu sinar tiba-tiba muncul di mata orang asing itu, menumpukan seluruh perhatian yang mampu dikumpulnya untuk mendengar apa yang akan dikatakan Neferteri.

8fdb4b36578a.en: “Morning, Sora! Yep, that’s him alright. He’s Harry by the way.” Itagiba gave off a cool smile, noticing where Sora was actually looking.
8fdb4b36578a.t: “Pagi, Sora! Ha, dialah tu. Nama dia Harry, by the way.” Itagiba memberikan senyuman bergaya, perasan ke mana Sora sebenarnya memandang.

92f5c8042d0e.en: Closing the odd-looking toilet, she cradled the fost lamp with her both hands. “Yes sir. Is there anything else you would like help with, sir Harry? The tub is ready for you.” Sora waved her hand towards the tub in the back of the bathroom, patiently waiting to strip Harry from his Bagarisa musk.
92f5c8042d0e.t: Menutup tandas yang kelihatan pelik itu, dia mendakap lampu fost itu dengan kedua-dua tangan. “Ya tuan. Ada apa-apa lagi yang tuan mahu saya bantu, Tuan Harry? Tab mandi sudah sedia untuk tuan.” Sora melambaikan tangannya ke arah tab mandi di belakang bilik mandi, menunggu dengan sabar untuk melucutkan kasturi Bagarisa dari Harry.

95e89f96fc9e.en: “Sora, he’s talking about your Darfaries vein.” Itagiba tapped Harry on the shoulder. “Man, your eyes are really that bad, huh?”
95e89f96fc9e.t: “Sora, dia cakap pasal urat Darfaries kau.” Itagiba menepuk bahu Harry. “Aduh, mata kau memang teruk macam tu, ya?”

966024760337.en: “Yo! You got a name?” The towering man in a blue fish-scale-covered tank top stood up in front of him, giving him his hand for a shake, and blocking the way to the cute girl with long purple hair. The amount of gold-colored clothing, plus the bluish crystals on his neck, gave him the appeal of a grandiose figure. His eyes sized the stranger’s overall body thickness, and total lack of sex appeal—or clothes for that matter.
966024760337.t: “Yo! Kau ada nama?” Lelaki tinggi lampai yang memakai baju tanpa lengan bersisik ikan biru berdiri di hadapannya, menghulurkan tangan untuk bersalam, dan menghalang laluan ke gadis comel berambut ungu panjang itu. Banyaknya pakaian berwarna emas, serta kristal kebiruan di lehernya, memberinya daya tarikan seorang tokoh yang hebat. Matanya menilai ketebalan tubuh orang asing itu secara keseluruhan, dan ketiadaan langsung daya tarikan seksualnya—atau pakaian, kalau nak dikira.

9675dbb19b13.en: “Ew. I was not the one who requested such a corpulent thing,” Eori’s cold-sounding voice was elegant like her mother’s, yet just as blunt as her father’s.
9675dbb19b13.t: “Eee. Bukan saya yang meminta benda gempal sebegitu,” suara Eori yang kedengaran dingin anggun seperti bondanya, namun sama tumpul seperti ayahandanya.
