97f9dd38b387.en: Meanwhile, Harry was looking at her cutesy hand laid out in front of him. Feeling a sense of peer pressure from behind, plus his own desires, he gulped as he carefully held it with both hands. It was slender, but just as warm, and comforting as Princess Eori’s. Still being careful, he touched the Darfaries vein; its red bumpiness was warmer than the rest of her hand, and had a certain toughness to it, but as his finger pressed slightly on it, it gave way to its squishiness.
97f9dd38b387.t: Sementara itu, Harry memandang tangan comel yang dihulurkan di hadapannya. Merasakan tekanan dari belakang, serta keinginannya sendiri, dia menelan liur sambil memegangnya dengan berhati-hati menggunakan kedua-dua tangan. Tangan itu ramping, tetapi sama hangat dan menenangkan seperti tangan Puteri Eori. Masih berhati-hati, dia menyentuh urat Darfaries itu; bonjolan merahnya lebih hangat daripada bahagian lain tangannya, dan mempunyai sedikit kekerasan, tetapi apabila jarinya menekannya sedikit, ia mengalah kepada kelembutannya.

981cbb3c560d.en: Chapter II subchapter 2: a man lies on a table under a window, one arm raised, in a room spattered with blood.
981cbb3c560d.t: Bab II subbab 2: seorang lelaki terbaring di atas meja di bawah tingkap, sebelah lengan terangkat, dalam bilik yang terpercik darah.

983c2e2501e6.en: The light stopped zooming around, and in the next second it struck him like a light cannon, taking away his senses.
983c2e2501e6.t: Cahaya itu berhenti meluncur, dan saat berikutnya ia menghentamnya seperti meriam cahaya, merampas segala derianya.

9927a95254b6.en: Itagiba let out a good hum. “Hmmm—you mentioned that before—what is that? Actually, never mind. Do me a solid and write down the recipe for Eiri, okay? I want to be surprised!”
9927a95254b6.t: Itagiba berdengung panjang. “Hmmm—kau ada sebut tadi—benda apa tu? Sebenarnya, tak payahlah. Tolong aku sikit, tuliskan resipinya untuk Eiri, okey? Aku nak rasa terkejut!”

99caa4d9a44d.en: Trying to keep some distance from the Bagarisa musk coming from Harry, Sora, standing at the door, placed her hand on the comfortable, leathery grayish-green couch. “Sir Harry—this is a couch—and you would use it to sit and read books and—” Sora trailed off mid-sentence, realizing Harry was looking elsewhere.
99caa4d9a44d.t: Cuba menjaga jarak daripada kasturi Bagarisa yang datang dari Harry, Sora, berdiri di pintu, meletakkan tangannya pada sofa kulit hijau kelabu yang selesa. “Tuan Harry—ini sofa—dan tuan menggunakannya untuk duduk dan membaca buku dan—” Sora terhenti di tengah ayat, menyedari Harry memandang ke tempat lain.

9a2d4884e5df.en: The stranger looked at himself, his skin completely fine. Plus he still had all limbs attached. But I am fine—Were they protecting me instead? But from what? What is this place anyway? Hmm?
9a2d4884e5df.t: Orang asing itu memandang dirinya, kulitnya langsung tidak apa-apa. Tambahan pula semua anggotanya masih lengkap. Tapi aku okey—Mereka melindungi aku ke sebenarnya? Tapi daripada apa? Tempat apa ni sebenarnya? Hmm?

9bf7cf73e81e.en: “That’s what she wants. So? Wanna marry her?” Itagiba cracked a wide smirk as his face was still right by the stranger’s, carefully watching for a response.
9bf7cf73e81e.t: “Itu yang dia nak. Jadi? Nak kahwin dengan dia?” Itagiba tersengih lebar sementara wajahnya masih betul-betul di sebelah wajah orang asing itu, memerhati dengan teliti jawapannya.

9d57d62b8d3e.en: “—Dear. Hold. We need a name.” Neferteri softly spoke, calling to her husband as he was about to herd the stranger away. Meanwhile, the stranger smelled his hand, frowning as he noticed his nose had grown accustomed to his own musk.
9d57d62b8d3e.t: “—Kanda. Tunggu. Kita perlukan nama.” Neferteri bercakap lembut, memanggil suaminya ketika dia hendak menggiring orang asing itu pergi. Sementara itu, orang asing itu menghidu tangannya, berkerut apabila menyedari hidungnya sudah terbiasa dengan baunya sendiri.

9e901329f96e.en: On what would be just another taco-beer-burp-taco-beer-taco-beer-fart-taco-beer loop, the white light began flickering the moment he was practicing playing his built-in smelly trombone. With blinking eyes, as if he had just come out of a long daydream, the corpulent man looked around; darkness to his left, darkness to his right, and darkness swallowing the backside. Everything around him was nothing but darkness. A feeling of being somewhere supposedly familiar, but yet feeling completely foreign gripped his insides; it was not another fart.
9e901329f96e.t: Dalam satu lagi kitaran taco-bir-sendawa-taco-bir-taco-bir-kentut-taco-bir yang biasa, cahaya putih itu mula berkelip-kelip tepat ketika dia sedang berlatih memainkan trombon busuk terbina dalamnya. Dengan mata terkebil-kebil, seolah-olah baru keluar dari lamunan panjang, lelaki gempal itu memandang sekeliling; gelap di kirinya, gelap di kanannya, dan kegelapan menelan bahagian belakang. Segala-galanya di sekelilingnya hanyalah kegelapan. Satu perasaan berada di suatu tempat yang sepatutnya biasa, namun terasa sepenuhnya asing mencengkam isi perutnya; itu bukan kentut lagi.

a020a2c8f3c0.en: Harry used his hand to cover his eyes, stepping back from whatever Sora was doing. Soon after, the lamp light began to dwindle, including its steam output, leaving a faint bioluminescence. “WOW! That was cool! Huh—are the stones smaller now?”
a020a2c8f3c0.t: Harry menutup matanya dengan tangan, berundur dari apa sahaja yang Sora sedang lakukan. Tidak lama kemudian, cahaya lampu itu mula berkurangan, termasuk wapnya, meninggalkan biopendarcahaya yang samar. “WOW! Itu best! Hah—batu-batu tu dah jadi kecil ke?”

a0b85159a429.en: Harry smiled, “Actually, yes, it’s just—some stuff looks weird to me. Like that. How's that a lamp?” Harry approached the supposed lamp, and picked it up. The top of the lamp had a hole about the size of a quarter, with two stones inside that had a glimmering radiance to them when inspected up close. How do you turn this on? Harry felt like there was something missing. “Don’t you have to, like, plug it or some—” He looked at the bottom of the lamp, rattling the stones inside as they clashed against the glass top. “There's no cable either—that’s weird.”
a0b85159a429.t: Harry tersenyum, “Sebenarnya, ya, cuma—sesetengah benda nampak pelik bagi saya. Macam tu. Macam mana itu boleh jadi lampu?” Harry mendekati benda yang disangkakan lampu itu, dan mengangkatnya. Bahagian atas lampu itu mempunyai lubang kira-kira sebesar syiling, dengan dua batu di dalamnya yang memancarkan kilauan apabila diperiksa dari dekat. Macam mana nak hidupkan ni? Harry merasakan ada sesuatu yang kurang. “Bukan ke kena, macam, cucuk plag atau—” Dia memandang bahagian bawah lampu itu, menggegarkan batu-batu di dalamnya sehingga berlaga dengan bahagian atas kaca. “Tak ada kabel juga—peliknya.”

a1527a8442fa.en: Meanwhile, Harry opened another drawer by the sink to put the timekeeper back, when he saw another familiar thing in purpose, but foreigner in aesthetic: a wooden toothbrush with red bristles, looking as if the bristles were pulled out of the back of some animal. By it, there was a fancy green porcelain jar with a greenish concoction inside that looked syrupy. Harry, placing the timekeeper back in a boxy wooden frame also inside the same drawer, grabbed the toothbrush, dipped it into the syrup, and brought it to his nose. A strong, but pleasant refreshing mint tickled it, then came the notes of green tea, and something citrusy about it. That’s an interesting toothpaste. Brushing a hearty amount of the syrup from the somewhat hard bristles on his tongue, it initially tasted something akin to nutmeg, then he felt as if someone punched him in the mouth. Ow fuck!—an explosion of flavor cocktail was so intense that most of his tongue grew numb. “Argh! Ow!”
a1527a8442fa.t: Sementara itu, Harry membuka laci lain di tepi sinki untuk menyimpan semula timekeeper itu, apabila dia nampak satu lagi benda yang biasa dari segi tujuannya, tetapi asing dari segi rupanya: berus gigi kayu dengan bulu merah, kelihatan seolah-olah bulunya dicabut dari belakang sejenis haiwan. Di sebelahnya, ada balang porselin hijau yang mewah berisi campuran kehijauan di dalamnya yang kelihatan seperti sirap. Harry, meletakkan semula timekeeper itu dalam bingkai kayu berbentuk kotak juga di dalam laci yang sama, mengambil berus gigi itu, mencelupnya ke dalam sirap, dan mendekatkannya ke hidung. Pudina yang kuat tetapi menyegarkan dan menyenangkan menggeletek hidungnya, kemudian datang aroma teh hijau, dan sesuatu yang berbau sitrus. Ubat gigi yang menarik. Memberus sejumlah besar sirap dari bulu yang agak keras itu ke lidahnya, mula-mula rasanya seperti buah pala, kemudian dia merasa seolah-olah seseorang menumbuk mulutnya. Aduh sial!—letupan koktel rasa itu begitu kuat sehingga sebahagian besar lidahnya kebas. “Argh! Aduh!”

a28cbd9d11f6.en: “I—I—guess so?” A strained cutesy voice came out of Sora, feeling the pressure, and Bagarisa musk coming from Harry as she stepped closer, slowly extending one of her slightly shaking hands towards him.
a28cbd9d11f6.t: “Sa—sa—saya rasa boleh?” Suara comel yang tegang keluar daripada Sora, merasakan tekanan, dan bau kasturi Bagarisa dari Harry ketika dia melangkah lebih dekat, perlahan-lahan menghulurkan sebelah tangannya yang sedikit menggeletar ke arahnya.

a3e9ef203150.en: “Tacos? The fuck is that?—Is it good?” The towering man interrupted the monologue with another verbal blunt strike.
a3e9ef203150.t: “Taco? Benda celaka apa tu?—Sedap ke?” Lelaki tinggi itu memotong monolog itu dengan satu lagi pukulan kata-kata yang tumpul.

a3f07d51cdae.en: That’s not how faucets work, right? Harry looked at Sora, as she carefully watched the fost lamp get close to half full before pressing on the lever with all her might. Next, she took out the funnel, dried it with a towel, put it away, then from the same drawer she grabbed a glass jar, filled with a white fine grain—that coincidentally also had a built-in funnel almost the size of the fost lamp hole. “Is that salt?” Harry followed the white grains plopping into the water, and falling towards the bottom.
a3f07d51cdae.t: Bukan macam tu cara pili air berfungsi, kan? Harry memandang Sora, ketika dia memerhati dengan teliti lampu fost itu hampir separuh penuh sebelum menekan tuil dengan sepenuh tenaga. Kemudian, dia mengeluarkan corong itu, mengeringkannya dengan tuala, menyimpannya, kemudian dari laci yang sama dia mengambil balang kaca berisi butiran halus berwarna putih—yang kebetulan juga mempunyai corong terbina dalam hampir sebesar lubang lampu fost itu. “Itu garam ke?” Harry mengekori butiran putih itu jatuh ke dalam air, dan tenggelam ke dasar.

a46a79e3e08f.en: She instead averted her eyes from him, fumbling her hands in front of an open blue door. “W–welcome to your guest room, sir Harry! I apologize for not bringing you proper clothes. Is there anything else you need?” Flushing red, but not as intensely as before, Sora peeked again at him, then back at the ground in front of him.
a46a79e3e08f.t: Sebaliknya gadis itu mengalihkan matanya darinya, menggerak-gerakkan tangannya di hadapan sebuah pintu biru yang terbuka. “S–selamat datang ke bilik tetamu tuan, Tuan Harry! Saya mohon maaf kerana tidak membawakan pakaian yang sesuai. Ada apa-apa lagi yang tuan perlukan?” Merah padam, tetapi tidak sehebat tadi, Sora mengintai lagi ke arahnya, kemudian kembali ke lantai di hadapannya.

a4a03a8d24fa.en: Nina, with her hand on her ears and somehow balancing herself purely on her stomach, nodded, then put up one finger with her left-hand, and four with the right-hand “TWENTY-SEVEN RAKUJAS!”
a4a03a8d24fa.t: Nina, dengan tangan di telinganya dan entah bagaimana mengimbangkan dirinya hanya pada perutnya, mengangguk, kemudian mengangkat satu jari dengan tangan kiri, dan empat dengan tangan kanan “DUA PULUH TUJUH RAKUJA!”

a4f2733c5b89.en: “Arrrrgggghhhh—hmph.” A loud burp nearly turned into vomit as this man’s stomach struggled with another horde of pig slop coming down his esophagus, but as soon as his stomach relented, he shoved down the last bite into his food hole. The saucy taco spilled down the sides of his mouth, then down his chin, and dripped on his chest.
a4f2733c5b89.t: “Arrrrgggghhhh—hmph.” Sendawa kuat hampir bertukar menjadi muntah ketika perut lelaki ini bergelut dengan satu lagi gerombolan makanan babi yang turun ke esofagusnya, tetapi sebaik sahaja perutnya mengalah, dia menyumbat gigitan terakhir ke dalam lubang makanannya. Taco yang bersos itu tertumpah di tepi mulutnya, kemudian ke dagunya, dan menitis ke dadanya.

a756a1f83cc6.en: Neferteri softly smiled. “Dear, you do not recall anything about your persona? Not even a name?”
a756a1f83cc6.t: Neferteri tersenyum lembut. “Sayang, kamu langsung tidak ingat apa-apa tentang diri kamu? Nama pun tidak?”

a795d3f207fc.en: Stating in a lower, mischievous voice, the king spoke into Harry’s ear. “Take a peek at the rails going up.”
a795d3f207fc.t: Dengan suara yang lebih perlahan dan nakal, raja berbisik di telinga Harry. “Cuba intai pagar tangga yang naik tu.”

a9802f0ea018.en: The stranger, feeling his sense of balance off, like he just got out of a rollercoaster, slowly stood up with his boxers in hand. Leaning his weight against the table, he put his feet through the holes, and started pulling the cloth up his legs. It felt quite comfortable at first with its higher quality breathable cotton rubbing on his skin, but as it got up closer to the waist, it certainly felt like it was not meant for him, leaving a clear imprint of his privates up front, and a slightly scratchy sensation on the stretchy fabric that rubbed on his waist.
a9802f0ea018.t: Orang asing itu, merasakan keseimbangannya terganggu, seperti baru turun dari roller coaster, perlahan-lahan berdiri dengan seluar dalam di tangan. Menyandarkan berat badannya pada meja, dia memasukkan kakinya ke dalam lubang, dan mula menarik kain itu ke atas kakinya. Ia terasa agak selesa pada mulanya dengan kapas berkualiti tinggi yang bernafas bergesel pada kulitnya, tetapi apabila ia semakin hampir ke pinggang, ia memang terasa bukan untuknya, meninggalkan bentuk jelas kemaluannya di depan, dan rasa sedikit gatal pada fabrik regang yang bergesel di pinggangnya.

aa5231c4ce15.en: Looking as if someone jumped-scared her, Sora quickly looked at her hands and arms, then at her clothing—appearing as if she was performing some form of senseless postmodern choreography. With her blush waning, she slightly furrowed her brow and tilted her neck. “I’m sorry, sir Harry, but where am I bleeding?”
aa5231c4ce15.t: Kelihatan seolah-olah seseorang baru mengejutkannya, Sora cepat-cepat memandang tangan dan lengannya, kemudian pakaiannya—kelihatan seolah-olah dia sedang mempersembahkan sejenis koreografi pascamoden yang tidak masuk akal. Dengan merah wajahnya semakin pudar, dia sedikit mengerutkan dahi dan menelengkan leher. “Maaf, Tuan Harry, tapi di mana saya berdarah?”

ac670eeefbe7.en: Itagiba waved his hand towards the stairs to let Harry walk up first. “King-maid. I will ask her to stop by and say hi. I mean, she would do that anyway.”
ac670eeefbe7.t: Itagiba melambaikan tangannya ke arah tangga untuk membiarkan Harry naik dulu. “King-maid. Aku akan minta dia singgah dan tegur kau. Maksud aku, dia memang akan buat pun.”

ad7a95acdc1d.en: He looked at his parents’ faces, but he could not see their expressions, or even how they looked. He looked back at the dog, but he was gone, and so were his parents. He now sat by himself, in a small apartment, looking much older than what he currently was.
ad7a95acdc1d.t: Dia memandang wajah ibu bapanya, tetapi dia tidak dapat melihat riak wajah mereka, malah rupa mereka pun. Dia memandang semula anjing itu, tetapi ia sudah tiada, begitu juga ibu bapanya. Kini dia duduk seorang diri, di sebuah pangsapuri kecil, kelihatan jauh lebih tua daripada usianya sekarang.

aee664a623c7.en: The stranger looked back and forth between the king and queen. Both were anxiously waiting for his response. He then glanced towards the beautiful princess, Eori, apparently busy looking at the flowers hugging the castle walls. I guess I can’t say no to this? They saved me after all. A nervous grin appeared on him as he imagined another princess in the same vein as the purple-haired one. “Yes!” the stranger said, with no further hesitation.
aee664a623c7.t: Orang asing itu memandang silih berganti antara raja dan permaisuri. Kedua-duanya menunggu jawapannya dengan cemas. Dia kemudian mengerling ke arah puteri yang cantik itu, Eori, nampaknya sibuk memandang bunga-bunga yang memeluk tembok istana. Rasanya aku tak boleh tolak ni? Mereka dah selamatkan aku. Sengihan gugup muncul di wajahnya ketika dia membayangkan seorang lagi puteri yang serupa dengan si rambut ungu itu. “Ya!” kata orang asing itu, tanpa ragu-ragu lagi.

b11c2d576cb0.en: “Shhh—she’s fine, see?” The king smiled, releasing the stranger. “CAN YOU GIVE HIM A NAME?” Itagiba loudly spoke to Nina.
b11c2d576cb0.t: “Shhh—dia okey, nampak?” Raja tersenyum, melepaskan orang asing itu. “BOLEH TAK KAU BAGI DIA NAMA?” Itagiba bercakap kuat kepada Nina.

b1fc09a9585d.en: “Hahaha—that’s what you get,” Itagiba busted out a belly laugh, with Eori, the princess in purple, showing a pleasurable grin on her face as she held back a soft laughter.
b1fc09a9585d.t: “Hahaha—padan muka,” Itagiba ketawa terbahak-bahak, dengan Eori, puteri berbaju ungu, menunjukkan sengihan puas di wajahnya sambil menahan ketawa kecil.

b29a03784e4a.en: The stranger opened his burning eyes to a blinding light, barely recognizing a blurry white ceiling above him. The stranger felt the blood pumping in his veins, a steady heartbeat in his chest that pricked his extremities, and his back uncomfortably resting against something hard that felt slightly moist, sticky.
b29a03784e4a.t: Orang asing itu membuka matanya yang pedih kepada cahaya yang menyilaukan, hampir tidak dapat mengecam siling putih yang kabur di atasnya. Orang asing itu merasakan darah mengepam dalam uratnya, degupan jantung yang tetap di dadanya yang mencucuk-cucuk hujung anggotanya, dan belakangnya berbaring dengan tidak selesa pada sesuatu yang keras yang terasa sedikit lembap dan melekit.

b2e11d1a0fc4.en: With his heart rate up, beads of sweat formed on Harry’s forehead. His body looked as if it was climbing a mountain, but in reality he was just finishing the first flight of stairs.
b2e11d1a0fc4.t: Dengan kadar degupan jantungnya meningkat, manik-manik peluh terbentuk di dahi Harry. Tubuhnya kelihatan seolah-olah sedang mendaki gunung, tetapi hakikatnya dia baru habis menaiki tangga tingkat pertama.

b41507ee13ec.en: The screen was a thin bezel TV that only showed a white bright light, with a constant noise, like what an old CRT used to make, but instead of a single high-pitched, ear-piercing noise, it sounded closer to heavy rain on a roof. However, if you paid close attention, it kinda felt like you could pick out a voice in a sea of voices, or an instrument within a thousand simultaneous orchestras.
b41507ee13ec.t: Skrin itu ialah TV berbingkai nipis yang hanya memaparkan cahaya putih terang, dengan bunyi berterusan, seperti yang dahulu dihasilkan oleh CRT lama, tetapi bukannya satu bunyi nyaring yang menusuk telinga, ia lebih kedengaran seperti hujan lebat di atas bumbung. Namun, jika diamati betul-betul, terasa seperti seseorang boleh menangkap satu suara di tengah lautan suara, atau satu alat muzik di dalam seribu orkestra yang bermain serentak.

b7e3035f1be4.en: Squinting his eyes hard, he tried to make out the room he was in. He saw a large—maybe broken—window, and a large splash of something red against the wall. Bookcases to the left and right of the window, and other wooden cabinets and a sink spread through the other walls—it had a strong utilitarian, doctor’s office appeal to it, especially with the table he was sitting at being dead-center in the room—the only thing it was missing were cringy posters of pharmaceutical companies trying to push medicine into patients, and a call-a-nurse button.
b7e3035f1be4.t: Mengecilkan matanya dengan kuat, dia cuba mengenal pasti bilik tempat dia berada. Dia nampak sebuah tingkap besar—mungkin pecah—dan percikan besar sesuatu yang merah di dinding. Rak buku di kiri dan kanan tingkap, serta kabinet kayu lain dan sinki tersebar di dinding-dinding lain—ia mempunyai daya tarikan pejabat doktor yang sangat praktikal, terutamanya dengan meja yang didudukinya berada tepat di tengah-tengah bilik—satu-satunya yang kurang hanyalah poster syarikat farmaseutikal yang menggelikan yang cuba menyumbat ubat kepada pesakit, dan butang memanggil jururawat.

b8c23973dccd.en: Itagiba hugged the stranger from the side, ignoring the Bagarisa musk coming from him; he spoke with a straight face right up close to his. “You can bug Gabiro for the details when he’s back! He’s like the smartest—smartass too—scientist in the block! But you still haven’t asked why we resurrected you! So let me tell you straight—we want you to marry one of our princesses—even if you stink like a Bagarisa.”
b8c23973dccd.t: Itagiba memeluk orang asing itu dari sisi, tidak mengendahkan bau kasturi Bagarisa yang datang daripadanya; dia bercakap dengan wajah serius betul-betul dekat dengan wajah orang asing itu. “Kau boleh kacau Gabiro untuk butirannya bila dia balik nanti! Dia macam saintis paling pandai—pandai kerek juga—kat kawasan ni! Tapi kau belum tanya lagi kenapa kami hidupkan kau semula! Jadi biar aku cakap terus terang—kami nak kau kahwin dengan salah seorang puteri kami—walaupun kau busuk macam Bagarisa.”

bc30f86b7495.en: “Yes, sir.” Sora put away the odd-looking saltshaker. Meanwhile, the mostly dissolved grains of salt reached the stones in the bottom, making white light sparkle across it, and forming small bubbles. As the salt-rich water further enveloped the whitish stones, the sparkles of light began joining together into a dim light that grew steadier.
bc30f86b7495.t: “Ya, tuan.” Sora menyimpan bekas garam yang kelihatan pelik itu. Sementara itu, butiran garam yang kebanyakannya sudah larut sampai ke batu-batu di dasar, membuatkan cahaya putih berkilauan di atasnya, dan membentuk gelembung-gelembung kecil. Ketika air yang kaya dengan garam itu terus menyelubungi batu-batu keputihan itu, kilauan cahaya mula bercantum menjadi cahaya malap yang semakin stabil.

bd47d190f680.en: “That’s my girl!” The king clapped with energy, of which Neferteri and Eori did not share.
bd47d190f680.t: “Itulah anak papa!” Raja bertepuk tangan dengan bertenaga, sesuatu yang tidak dikongsi oleh Neferteri dan Eori.

bd7e15b70651.en: The TV, with its last flickering light, finally gave its last burst. The darkness, that forever waited patiently, now finally had the opportunity to strike.
bd7e15b70651.t: TV itu, dengan cahaya berkelipnya yang terakhir, akhirnya memancarkan letusan penghabisan. Kegelapan, yang selama ini menunggu dengan sabar, kini akhirnya mendapat peluang untuk menyerang.

be7c074ee4d7.en: Harry looked around the room and saw a few wooden cabinets and two square containers—one with a lid that looked like a trashcan, and another that looked like a laundry basket. “Eh—I think I get the rest. Thanks again, Sora!”
be7c074ee4d7.t: Harry memandang sekeliling bilik dan nampak beberapa kabinet kayu dan dua bekas segi empat—satu dengan penutup yang kelihatan seperti tong sampah, dan satu lagi yang kelihatan seperti bakul dobi. “Eh—rasanya saya faham yang lain. Terima kasih sekali lagi, Sora!”

c0768cd3ac2f.en: A suppressed girly moan came out of the maid, Sora, while her body slightly shivered.
c0768cd3ac2f.t: Erangan gadis yang tertahan keluar daripada si pembantu rumah, Sora, sementara tubuhnya sedikit menggigil.

c0b3c9202afe.en: What is this place? He kept squinting as he looked for something familiar, but there was nothing amongst the pile of stuff thrown all over the place that hinted at it.
c0b3c9202afe.t: Tempat apa ni? Dia terus mengecilkan mata sambil mencari sesuatu yang biasa, tetapi tiada apa-apa di antara timbunan barang yang bersepah di merata tempat yang memberi petunjuk.

c1e4fb287773.en: Looking towards the back of the room, Harry saw a window, and right below it, a neatly set, comfortable-looking single person bed. To the left of the room there was another normal-looking door, closed, and beside it a large painting of a guy, looking like an older version of Itagiba, fishing from the clouds while being pulled by an animal that looked like a horse. Below that painting, there was a desk with ink in five different hues: yellow, red, green, blue, and black, plus the same nari stone he had seen before, but now they were individually laid out neatly below the inks. “Can I ask what that is?” Harry’s eyes noticed a blur of a glass-and-wood lamp-looking thing with two whitish stones inside resting on top of a nightstand. “They are like—everywhere.”
c1e4fb287773.t: Memandang ke belakang bilik, Harry nampak sebuah tingkap, dan betul-betul di bawahnya, sebuah katil bujang yang tersusun kemas dan kelihatan selesa. Di sebelah kiri bilik ada sebuah lagi pintu yang kelihatan biasa, tertutup, dan di sebelahnya sebuah lukisan besar seorang lelaki, yang kelihatan seperti versi tua Itagiba, memancing dari awan sambil ditarik oleh seekor haiwan yang kelihatan seperti kuda. Di bawah lukisan itu, ada sebuah meja tulis dengan dakwat dalam lima warna berbeza: kuning, merah, hijau, biru dan hitam, serta batu nari yang sama yang dia nampak sebelum ini, tetapi kini disusun kemas satu persatu di bawah dakwat-dakwat itu. “Boleh saya tanya itu apa?” Mata Harry perasan sesuatu yang kabur seperti lampu kaca dan kayu dengan dua batu keputihan di dalamnya terletak di atas meja sisi katil. “Benda tu ada—kat mana-mana.”

c2b615a129bb.en: The other floor below was the exact same, except there were faint bloody footprints from the bottom stairs going into the main door. The stranger, feeling as if he was being peer pressured, even though there were no peers around him, stepped closer to the door, only to hear a constant beating rhythm—like an eagerly quickening clap. His hand clenched to a fist, ready to knock at the door, but looking at the bloodied footprints, his face clenched as well, making his hand avoid the mysteriousness of that side quest.
c2b615a129bb.t: Tingkat seterusnya di bawah betul-betul sama, kecuali ada kesan tapak kaki berdarah yang samar dari anak tangga bawah menuju ke pintu utama. Orang asing itu, merasakan seolah-olah dia ditekan rakan sebaya, walaupun tiada rakan sebaya di sekelilingnya, melangkah mendekati pintu itu, hanya untuk mendengar rentak ketukan yang berterusan—seperti tepukan yang semakin laju dengan bersemangat. Tangannya mengepal menjadi penumbuk, bersedia mengetuk pintu, tetapi melihat kesan tapak kaki berdarah itu, wajahnya turut mengepal, membuatkan tangannya mengelak misteri misi sampingan itu.

c58f4746ab79.en: The darker skinned lady came closer to the towering men and put her hand on his left shoulder. “Honey, let him speak.” Her eyes glared at the stranger as well, appearing to analyze everything he said, or did, maybe even how quickly he was breathing.
c58f4746ab79.t: Wanita berkulit lebih gelap itu mendekati lelaki tinggi itu dan meletakkan tangannya di bahu kirinya. “Kanda, biarkan dia bercakap.” Matanya turut merenung tajam orang asing itu, kelihatan menganalisis segala yang dia katakan atau lakukan, malah mungkin betapa laju dia bernafas.

c6be0c4d3e8e.en: “But Mom! This fatso looks like him!” Nina had a sweet, innocent tone to her childish voice, but her devious grin contrasted it like day and night.
c6be0c4d3e8e.t: “Tapi Mama! Si gemuk ni memang macam dia!” Suara keanak-anakan Nina bernada manis dan polos, tetapi sengih nakalnya bertentangan dengannya seperti siang dan malam.

c787ee3df9f9.en: “Yeah. She takes care of the maids, and the accounting of the kingdom,” Itagiba replied without thinking, as if this answer has been given to people many times.
c787ee3df9f9.t: “Ha. Dia jaga para pembantu rumah, dan perakaunan kerajaan,” Itagiba menjawab tanpa berfikir, seolah-olah jawapan ini sudah diberikan kepada ramai orang berkali-kali.

c788c7632db9.en: Marry one of our princesses. Itagiba’s words echoed in the stranger’s brain, unable to be processed, not because he couldn’t, but rather he never thought those words would be spoken. His brain, stuck on a BSOD, did not give any further instructions, so he was stuck in a paralyzed blinking motion until a ding occurred when his brain finally rebooted. His jaw dropped, and he immediately turned his head towards Eori’s beautiful face—his blue eyes widened so much it was about to fall from his eye sockets.
c788c7632db9.t: Kahwin dengan salah seorang puteri kami. Kata-kata Itagiba bergema dalam otak orang asing itu, tidak dapat diproses, bukan kerana tidak boleh, tetapi kerana dia tidak pernah menyangka kata-kata itu akan diucapkan. Otaknya, tersekat pada skrin biru maut, tidak memberi sebarang arahan lanjut, jadi dia tersekat dalam gerakan berkelip yang lumpuh sehinggalah bunyi ding kedengaran apabila otaknya akhirnya but semula. Rahangnya terlopong, dan dia serta-merta berpaling ke arah wajah cantik Eori—mata birunya terbeliak sehingga hampir terjatuh dari soket matanya.

c84205aca9a1.en: The stranger felt like he was punched in the liver when Eori said ew, but that was only the start of it. With the rest of her eloquent speech, he felt like she, emotionally speaking, had just given him a fatality combo, akin to the gruesome, spine-ripping ones found in popular combat games. He could not muster anything to reply back, for he also felt locked in place by Itagiba’s strong arm around his neck.
c84205aca9a1.t: Orang asing itu terasa seperti ditumbuk di hati apabila Eori berkata eee, tetapi itu baru permulaan. Dengan baki ucapannya yang petah, dia merasakan seolah-olah gadis itu, dari segi emosi, baru sahaja memberinya kombo maut, seperti yang mengerikan dan merentap tulang belakang dalam permainan pertarungan yang popular. Dia tidak dapat membalas apa-apa, kerana dia juga terasa terkunci di tempatnya oleh lengan kuat Itagiba yang melingkari lehernya.

c8acb1ac8836.en: A heavy man, whose body shape would definitely require a seat for each buttock if he were to try to ride a train, sat in a red recliner that molded to his body perfectly, as if he had used it for an eternity. Behind thick square glasses, dirty with his own oily grimy skin, his eyes looked fervently at a white screen; no different than a deer looking at a truck’s headlight, moments away from experiencing the thrill of sudden change of momentum.
c8acb1ac8836.t: Seorang lelaki gempal, yang bentuk badannya pasti memerlukan satu tempat duduk untuk setiap belah punggung jika dia cuba menaiki kereta api, duduk di atas kerusi malas merah yang mengikut bentuk tubuhnya dengan sempurna, seolah-olah dia sudah menggunakannya sejak azali. Di sebalik cermin mata segi empat yang tebal, kotor dengan kulitnya sendiri yang berminyak dan berdaki, matanya merenung bersungguh-sungguh ke arah skrin putih; tidak ubah seperti rusa yang merenung lampu hadapan trak, beberapa saat sebelum merasai keseronokan perubahan momentum secara mengejut.

ca3d4e4bd06e.en: “Dear, please tell us everything you might remember. You can trust us.” She extended her hand as well, briefly meeting the stranger’s. “For I am Neferteri Sanbi Royal, the queen of Sanbi, and this is the king, Itagiba Sanbi Royal.”
ca3d4e4bd06e.t: “Sayang, sila ceritakan kepada kami segala yang mungkin kamu ingat. Kamu boleh mempercayai kami.” Wanita itu turut menghulurkan tangannya, bertemu seketika dengan tangan orang asing itu. “Kerana saya ialah Neferteri Sanbi Royal, permaisuri Sanbi, dan ini raja, Itagiba Sanbi Royal.”

cb1d77f5ab71.en: Sora, looking at the tip of her middle and ring fingers, took note of the red vein-like pattern that bumped out of her virgin skin. She carefully watched the vein appear from the tip of her fingers towards the back of the hand where it merged into a larger vein as it continued down her forearm. She pulled on her black sleeve, revealing the same larger red vein-like thing going all the way up her forearm, getting as thick as a pencil with additional branches coming off the large vein.
cb1d77f5ab71.t: Sora, memandang hujung jari tengah dan jari manisnya, perasan corak merah seperti urat yang timbul dari kulitnya yang mulus. Dia memerhati dengan teliti urat itu muncul dari hujung jarinya ke belakang tangan di mana ia bergabung dengan urat yang lebih besar sambil terus menjalar ke lengan bawahnya. Dia menarik lengan bajunya yang hitam, mendedahkan urat merah yang lebih besar yang sama menjalar sepanjang lengan bawahnya, sebesar pensel dengan cabang-cabang tambahan yang keluar dari urat besar itu.

cb34b7f0d313.en: The stranger clapped as well, trying to follow the same enthusiastic fatherly energy, but he was offbeat, for his concentration was also divided in noticing how the queen and Eori behaved indifferently to this spectacle.
cb34b7f0d313.t: Orang asing itu turut bertepuk tangan, cuba mengikut tenaga kebapaan yang bersemangat itu, tetapi rentaknya sumbang, kerana tumpuannya juga terbahagi kerana perasan bagaimana permaisuri dan Eori berkelakuan acuh tak acuh terhadap pertunjukan ini.

cb3f2af9ecd6.en: “Yes, sir. Right now it is Sunnolow, which is why that half timehunk is lit up. When the other half lights up instead, it will be Sunnohigh. Please make yourself at home—and, sir Harry—please enjoy your bath!” Sora ended with a tone as if she was pleading her case to a policeman, right before being arrested. “—there is plenty of time until Monnalow!” Sora, holding her nose away from Harry, looked away, fidgeting with her hands, ashamed of what she was trying to say.
cb3f2af9ecd6.t: “Ya, tuan. Sekarang ialah Sunnolow, sebab itulah separuh timehunk itu menyala. Apabila separuh lagi menyala, ia akan menjadi Sunnohigh. Silakan buat seperti rumah sendiri—dan, Tuan Harry—silakan nikmati mandian tuan!” Sora mengakhiri dengan nada seolah-olah dia sedang merayu kepada polis, sebelum ditangkap. “—masih banyak masa sehingga Monnalow!” Sora, menjauhkan hidungnya dari Harry, memandang ke arah lain, bermain-main dengan tangannya, malu dengan apa yang cuba dikatakannya.

cbf2b34bf806.en: Harry squinted back at Eori, trying to steal a last glance of her, but saw her looking firmly at him, almost with a suspicious gaze, before hiding her face away from him.
cbf2b34bf806.t: Harry mengecilkan mata memandang Eori, cuba mencuri pandang buat kali terakhir, tetapi melihatnya memandang tegas kepadanya, hampir dengan renungan curiga, sebelum menyembunyikan wajahnya darinya.

cd39af7ebcca.en: “My pleasure, sir Harry. A maid will bring you some tea on Sunnohigh.” Sora excused herself again, and made her way out of the room, closing the bathroom door.
cd39af7ebcca.t: “Sama-sama, Tuan Harry. Seorang pembantu rumah akan membawakan teh untuk tuan pada Sunnohigh.” Sora meminta diri sekali lagi, dan keluar dari bilik, menutup pintu bilik mandi.

cd81b13016fa.en: Prepping to get off the table, he looked down on his lap, and saw a white cloth with red stars embroidered suspiciously covering his manhood. His inquisitive eyes turned to the cloth, realizing it was a pair of boxers. That’s not mine—actually, this seems kinda small. Wait a minute! My dick! I can see it now? His jaw dropped while his hands reached to his not-as-swollen gut, grabbing the no-longer-as-thick-and-juicy blabber folds of his bottom belly. How did I lose all this weight?—or was I even that fat to begin with?
cd81b13016fa.t: Bersedia untuk turun dari meja, dia memandang ke riba, dan ternampak sehelai kain putih bersulam bintang merah menutupi kejantanannya dengan mencurigakan. Matanya yang ingin tahu beralih kepada kain itu, menyedari ia sepasang seluar dalam. Itu bukan aku punya—sebenarnya, ni macam kecil sikit. Kejap! Konek aku! Aku boleh nampak sekarang? Rahangnya terlopong sementara tangannya mencapai perutnya yang tidak sebuncit dulu, menggenggam lipatan lemak perut bawahnya yang tidak lagi setebal dan semontok dulu. Macam mana aku boleh turun berat sebanyak ni?—atau aku memang tak segemuk tu pun?

cef8e04adbab.en: Harry looked back to the toilet, still with the time-keeping instrument in his hand. How do I know that’s a toilet, but not this time thingy? Was I born here? Amidst his thoughts, Itagiba’s voice came back to him. Soul Death. Opening his eyes wide, Harry remembered a piece of convo that slipped out of Itagiba’s mouth, which did not even register initially. So, the soul does exist—a toothbrush?
cef8e04adbab.t: Harry memandang semula tandas itu, masih dengan alat penunjuk masa di tangannya. Macam mana aku tahu itu tandas, tapi tak tahu benda masa ni? Aku lahir kat sini ke? Di tengah-tengah fikirannya, suara Itagiba kembali kepadanya. Mati jiwa. Membuka matanya luas-luas, Harry teringat sepotong perbualan yang terlepas dari mulut Itagiba, yang langsung tidak diendahkannya pada mulanya. Jadi, jiwa memang wujud—berus gigi?

d39876e47b32.en: Puffing, and huffing, Harry pushed his feet upstairs one at a time. His heart, pounding on his neck, as beads of sweat ran down his Bagarisa-musk-soaked skin.
d39876e47b32.t: Tercungap-cungap, Harry menolak kakinya naik satu demi satu. Jantungnya berdegup kencang di leher, sementara manik-manik peluh mengalir di kulitnya yang basah dengan kasturi Bagarisa.

d48351a75f0a.en: “Attaboy! Now come with me! I can’t have you smelling like a bagarisa’s asshole when you meet her!” Itagiba let him go, and gestured his hand towards the farthest-off tower.
d48351a75f0a.t: “Bagus, budak! Sekarang ikut aku! Aku tak boleh biar kau berbau macam lubang bontot bagarisa bila jumpa dia!” Itagiba melepaskannya, dan menggerakkan tangannya ke arah menara yang paling jauh.

d488935c5387.en: “Naked Bruntos?” Harry furrowed his brow. “Sorry, I’m confused—”
d488935c5387.t: “Naked Bruntos?” Harry mengerutkan dahi. “Maaf, saya keliru—”

d5e23f994ae1.en: However, amongst the remaining memories, not as yet faded, he saw himself holding a knife against his own chest as he sobbed. He did not look as fat, but he did look just as worn out. Dropping the knife back in the kitchen counter, he felt misery, emptiness, yet a faint hope. He wanted to live because of that single thread of hope, but the sweet relief of death kept gnawing at it.
d5e23f994ae1.t: Namun, di antara ingatan yang masih tinggal, yang belum pudar, dia melihat dirinya memegang pisau ke dadanya sendiri sambil teresak-esak. Dia tidak kelihatan segemuk itu, tetapi dia kelihatan sama letihnya. Menjatuhkan semula pisau itu ke atas kaunter dapur, dia merasakan kesengsaraan, kekosongan, namun ada secebis harapan. Dia mahu hidup kerana seutas benang harapan itu, tetapi kelegaan manis kematian terus menggigitnya.

d9cc5f83fa5d.en: “Nina!” A woman of dark skin and long black hair spoke with a firm motherly tone as her eyes stared daggers back at the child in pink.
d9cc5f83fa5d.t: “Nina!” Seorang wanita berkulit gelap dan berambut hitam panjang bercakap dengan nada keibuan yang tegas sambil matanya menikam tajam ke arah kanak-kanak berbaju merah jambu itu.

d9d3a13081b9.en: The sheer panic in her voice made Harry anxious as well. “The—the red thing on—on the back of your hand? Yeah! That!” Harry gestured with his hands to replicate where he was seeing the supposed blood.
d9d3a13081b9.t: Rasa panik dalam suaranya membuatkan Harry turut cemas. “Ben—benda merah kat—kat belakang tangan awak? Ha! Tu!” Harry menggerakkan tangannya untuk menunjukkan di mana dia nampak darah yang disangkakan itu.

d9e218dd10ca.en: Feeling compelled to know more, the stranger made his way out of the room. Near the entrance, he saw a broken glass and wooden container that had two white stones within it. It was blurry, but he could see glass shards littered around it. Leaving that aside, he carefully placed his weight on the wobbly fallen door, only to see more glass-looking things with more whitish stones inside hanging from the ceiling as if it was a lamp. That’s weird. The stranger squinted his eyes as he passed underneath it towards the stairs.
d9e218dd10ca.t: Terasa terdorong untuk mengetahui lebih lanjut, orang asing itu keluar dari bilik. Berhampiran pintu masuk, dia nampak sebuah bekas kaca dan kayu yang pecah dengan dua batu putih di dalamnya. Ia kabur, tetapi dia dapat melihat serpihan kaca bersepah di sekelilingnya. Membiarkannya, dia dengan berhati-hati meletakkan berat badannya pada pintu tumbang yang bergoyang, hanya untuk melihat lebih banyak benda seperti kaca dengan lebih banyak batu keputihan di dalamnya tergantung dari siling seolah-olah ia lampu. Peliknya. Orang asing itu mengecilkan matanya ketika melintas di bawahnya menuju ke tangga.

da607efa0ef7.en: Chapter II subchapter 3: several people stand around a large dead black bird in a courtyard, including Harry in starred shorts.
da607efa0ef7.t: Bab II subbab 3: beberapa orang berdiri di sekeliling burung hitam besar yang mati di sebuah halaman, termasuk Harry yang berseluar pendek bercorak bintang.

ddd3d5c1025f.en: Is that a letter, too? The stranger felt an odd sensation as he felt Nina initially monkey around looking like she had a stroke, but as soon as she finished a stream of weird line motions, somehow the meaning of it made sense in his head. R? Is that really R?
ddd3d5c1025f.t: Itu huruf juga ke? Orang asing itu merasakan sensasi aneh ketika dia melihat Nina pada mulanya terkinja-kinja seperti orang diserang strok, tetapi sebaik sahaja dia selesai membuat siri gerakan garis yang pelik itu, entah bagaimana maknanya masuk akal dalam kepalanya. R? Betul ke tu R?

e056ac8a60f1.en: Itagiba, with an increasingly devilish look, switched to a smoother tone. “Can you show it to him?”
e056ac8a60f1.t: Itagiba, dengan rupa yang semakin nakal, bertukar ke nada yang lebih lunak. “Boleh kau tunjuk kat dia?”

e0c95b87145d.en: The fat man felt the darkness pulling him away from it, hiding him, consuming the rest of him like he was trapped in the belly of a beast. Just like the sensation he had when he pointed the knife at his own chest, despair and misery took over, but with it a nearly shredded thread of hope. “I DON’T WANNA DIE!” he screamed, but no sound came out. Sobbing like a baby, his hand moved towards the light.
e0c95b87145d.t: Lelaki gemuk itu merasakan kegelapan menariknya menjauhi cahaya itu, menyembunyikannya, menelan baki dirinya seperti dia terperangkap dalam perut seekor binatang. Sama seperti perasaan ketika dia menghalakan pisau ke dadanya sendiri, keputusasaan dan kesengsaraan mengambil alih, tetapi bersamanya ada seutas benang harapan yang hampir putus. “AKU TAK NAK MATI!” dia menjerit, tetapi tiada bunyi yang keluar. Teresak-esak seperti bayi, tangannya bergerak ke arah cahaya itu.

e0d51c436a88.en: “Please!” Harry’s eyes shone in a glimmering radiance just like the whitish stones.
e0d51c436a88.t: “Tolong!” Mata Harry bersinar berkilauan sama seperti batu-batu keputihan itu.

e157181e02f7.en: *One, two, three—*Using his finger, Harry counted a total of sixteen sections. The numbers look off. He looked at Sora, playing with her hands, as her black shoes and torso pointed to the door, apparently eager to leave the bathroom for some reason—possibly because of the lingering Bagarisa stench growing stronger. “Isn’t there like twenty-four hours?”
e157181e02f7.t: *Satu, dua, tiga—*Menggunakan jarinya, Harry mengira sejumlah enam belas bahagian. Nombornya macam tak kena. Dia memandang Sora, yang bermain dengan tangannya, sementara kasut hitam dan tubuhnya menghala ke pintu, nampaknya tidak sabar untuk meninggalkan bilik mandi atas sebab tertentu—mungkin kerana bau busuk Bagarisa yang semakin kuat. “Bukan ke ada macam dua puluh empat jam?”

e218b256d87a.en: Sora, now the one huffing as she grabbed the half-full fost lamp out of the sink, used all her strength to shake the water to properly mix it, turning the dim lamp into a little sun that lit the bathroom in pure, blinding white light, alongside a steam noise that sounded like a tea kettle about to boil.
e218b256d87a.t: Sora, kini dia pula yang tercungap ketika mengambil lampu fost yang separuh penuh itu dari sinki, menggunakan seluruh kekuatannya untuk menggoncang air itu supaya bercampur dengan betul, mengubah lampu malap itu menjadi matahari kecil yang menerangi bilik mandi dengan cahaya putih tulen yang menyilaukan, bersama bunyi wap yang kedengaran seperti cerek hendak mendidih.

e23b45472f9f.en: I—guess so? The stranger felt his tense shoulders relaxing, “Thank you!”
e23b45472f9f.t: Ri—rasanya boleh? Orang asing itu merasakan bahunya yang tegang mengendur, “Terima kasih!”

e6d7882d0c64.en: “Nice to meet you, sir Harry.” Sora glanced towards Harry quickly, then held her cutesy hands in front of her as she bowed slightly. “I’m Sora Sanbi Blue-glass!”
e6d7882d0c64.t: “Selamat berkenalan, Tuan Harry.” Sora mengerling Harry dengan pantas, kemudian memegang tangannya yang comel di hadapannya sambil sedikit menunduk. “Saya Sora Sanbi Blue-glass!”

e717b4291596.en: Extending her hands as far as she could towards Harry, she acquired the lamp from him, then opened the normal-looking door to the side, revealing it was a modest-looking bathroom. Placing the fost lamp on a nearby sink, she opened a nearby drawer, picked up a wood funnel, and jammed its near perfect fit on the small top hole of the lamp that itself aligned up to a hole from the pipe in the wall. Stretching her arm towards a handle in the same pipe, she pulled on it with a bit of force, causing water to angrily rush out from the hole, into the funnel, shockingly gargling its way into the fost lamp—if Poseidon was ever waterboarded by a three-letter agency, it would probably sound like that.
e717b4291596.t: Menghulurkan tangannya sejauh mungkin ke arah Harry, gadis itu mengambil lampu itu daripadanya, kemudian membuka pintu yang kelihatan biasa di sisi, mendedahkan sebuah bilik mandi yang sederhana. Meletakkan lampu fost itu di atas sinki berdekatan, dia membuka laci berdekatan, mengambil corong kayu, dan menyumbatnya dengan muat hampir sempurna pada lubang kecil di atas lampu yang dengan sendirinya sejajar dengan lubang dari paip di dinding. Menghulurkan lengannya ke arah pemegang pada paip yang sama, dia menariknya dengan sedikit tenaga, menyebabkan air menerjah keluar dengan marah dari lubang, masuk ke corong, berkumur-kumur dengan mengejutkan masuk ke dalam lampu fost—jika Poseidon pernah diseksa dengan air oleh agensi tiga huruf, mungkin begitulah bunyinya.

e907867f39ee.en: Biting the inside of his cheek, the stranger shook his head. “I’m sorry, but I just don’t know.”
e907867f39ee.t: Menggigit bahagian dalam pipinya, orang asing itu menggeleng. “Maaf, tapi saya memang tak tahu.”

ea18ff71c955.en: Sora nodded, giggling as she glanced at Harry, looking like a kid in a ball pit for the first time. “Hehe—please don’t tell Eiri, but I knew you would appreciate it, sir Harry!” She opened the top of a boxy-looking thing, revealing a familiar looking bathroom staple, a toilet. The toilet also had an attached pipe that ran up the wall with a similar handle as the other pipe.
ea18ff71c955.t: Sora mengangguk, mengekek sambil mengerling Harry, yang kelihatan seperti budak dalam kolam bola buat pertama kali. “Hehe—tolong jangan beritahu Eiri, tapi saya tahu tuan akan menghargainya, Tuan Harry!” Dia membuka bahagian atas sesuatu yang berbentuk kotak, mendedahkan barang keperluan bilik mandi yang kelihatan biasa, tandas. Tandas itu juga mempunyai paip yang dipasang menjalar ke dinding dengan pemegang yang serupa seperti paip lain.

ea9ba9d1cf4f.en: The stranger could not see well, but he did see enough to feel a sense of impending doom; imagining this tiny girl falling, and splattering in the grass down below. A peak of energy rushed his body. He attempted to take off after her, but the king held him at the shoulder.
ea9ba9d1cf4f.t: Orang asing itu tidak dapat melihat dengan jelas, tetapi dia nampak cukup untuk merasakan malapetaka yang bakal tiba; membayangkan gadis kecil ini jatuh, dan berkecai di atas rumput di bawah. Satu lonjakan tenaga menerpa tubuhnya. Dia cuba meluru ke arahnya, tetapi raja memegang bahunya.

eb05898cbe04.en: Nothing strange happened, and with the certainty that he was relaxing in a bathtub, his shoulders involuntarily dropped, succumbing to the comforting warmth. With the tension melting away, it was time for his belly to rumble with an important request, one he could not deny as his intestines now felt like someone was twisting them. Harry let out a grunt, his face contorting as the twisting got lower and lower in his gut, followed by a small explosion in the water, making the whole tub vibrate like a phone ringing on a wooden table. The next second, a large bubble popped in the surface of the water, and with it the stench of death cursed the air around, far more pungent than a Bagarisa’s musk. With a blanching face, he tried to fan the smell outwards, but it was not enough. Turning his head towards the window, he sloppily attacked it with one hand, luckily making it open outwardly.
eb05898cbe04.t: Tiada perkara aneh berlaku, dan dengan kepastian bahawa dia sedang bersantai dalam tab mandi, bahunya terlorot tanpa sengaja, tunduk kepada kehangatan yang selesa. Dengan ketegangan yang mencair, tiba masanya perutnya berkeroncong dengan permintaan penting, yang tidak dapat ditolaknya kerana ususnya kini terasa seperti dipulas seseorang. Harry merengus, wajahnya berkerut ketika pulasan itu semakin ke bawah dalam perutnya, diikuti letupan kecil di dalam air, membuatkan seluruh tab bergetar seperti telefon berdering di atas meja kayu. Saat berikutnya, satu gelembung besar pecah di permukaan air, dan bersamanya bau busuk kematian menyumpah udara di sekeliling, jauh lebih hamis daripada kasturi Bagarisa. Dengan wajah pucat, dia cuba mengipas bau itu keluar, tetapi tidak mencukupi. Memalingkan kepalanya ke arah tingkap, dia menyerangnya dengan sebelah tangan secara cuai, nasib baik membuatkannya terbuka ke luar.

ed359447198a.en: Itagiba turned his head towards the castle. “HEY NINA!” he screamed at the top of his lungs.
ed359447198a.t: Itagiba memalingkan kepalanya ke arah istana. “HEI NINA!” dia menjerit sekuat hati.

f1027aa5b770.en: Chapter II - Stranger · Vol 1 - Failed Experiment · #HusbandOutWorld
f1027aa5b770.t: Bab II - Orang Asing · Jilid 1 - Eksperimen Gagal · #HusbandOutWorld

f1aff528ae77.en: “DEAL!” Itagiba let out a laugh through his nose, while his face remained business casual.
f1aff528ae77.t: “SETUJU!” Itagiba ketawa melalui hidung, sementara wajahnya kekal bersahaja seperti urusan perniagaan.

f2c924f9b5d7.en: A playful balance with his life threaded on that same line.
f2c924f9b5d7.t: Hidupnya bermain tarik tali dengan dirinya sendiri di atas benang yang sama.

f3c74c9779d5.en: Neferteri and Eori both stood back. Eori kept averting her gaze, while Neferteri smiled as she carefully sized up, or rather analyzed, Harry as he was taken away by Itagiba.
f3c74c9779d5.t: Neferteri dan Eori sama-sama berdiri di belakang. Eori terus mengelak pandangan, sementara Neferteri tersenyum sambil menilai dengan teliti, atau lebih tepat, menganalisis Harry ketika dia dibawa pergi oleh Itagiba.

f64b1966980f.en: Pulling the goth chicken’s head feathers around as if it was a joystick, Nina, still mounted on the bird, stepped closer to the stranger. With her small cutesy right hand up in the air, she clearly wanted a high-five. The stranger took a second or so to realize her request, and as his hand went to high-five her tiny hands, she bamboozled him by slipping it downwards, and used it as a poking stick into his belly button. Spitting all over, she made a wet fart sound with her mouth. “Pfffff—ewww it’s wet!” Dropping her act, she quickly took out her finger, and, for no apparent reason, put it up right below her nose, only to take a deep whiff, and gag profusely from the je ne sais quoi smell of Bagarisa musk.
f64b1966980f.t: Menarik-narik bulu kepala ayam goth itu seolah-olah ia kayu bedik, Nina, masih menunggang burung itu, melangkah mendekati orang asing itu. Dengan tangan kanannya yang kecil dan comel diangkat ke udara, dia jelas mahu tepuk tangan tinggi. Orang asing itu mengambil masa sesaat dua untuk memahami permintaannya, dan ketika tangannya hendak menepuk tangan kecilnya, dia memperdayakannya dengan mengalihkannya ke bawah, dan menggunakannya sebagai kayu pencucuk ke dalam pusatnya. Meludah merata-rata, dia membuat bunyi kentut basah dengan mulutnya. “Pfffff—eee basah!” Menghentikan lakonannya, dia cepat-cepat menarik keluar jarinya, dan, tanpa sebab yang jelas, meletakkannya betul-betul di bawah hidungnya, hanya untuk menghidu dalam-dalam, dan termuntah-muntah teruk kerana bau je ne sais quoi kasturi Bagarisa.

f69a61097a30.en: For a moment, the king of Sanbi appeared to hold back wanting to say something. His concerned eyes then disappeared, pushing Harry to keep going upstairs. “One more! We can do it! Let’s go!”
f69a61097a30.t: Seketika, raja Sanbi kelihatan menahan diri daripada mahu mengatakan sesuatu. Mata risaunya kemudian hilang, menolak Harry untuk terus menaiki tangga. “Satu lagi! Kita boleh! Jom!”

f6ec32cc5ebd.en: “Yes, please!” Nodding, Harry followed after Sora. At the blue door, Harry spotted a mid-sized living quarters. To his right there were a few wooden bookshelves, dressers, and a couch where Sora stood by.
f6ec32cc5ebd.t: “Ya, tolong!” Mengangguk, Harry mengikut Sora. Di pintu biru itu, Harry ternampak sebuah ruang kediaman bersaiz sederhana. Di sebelah kanannya ada beberapa rak buku kayu, almari laci, dan sebuah sofa tempat Sora berdiri.

f79c64bc0a9b.en: The stranger placed his hands over his eyes and ears, trying to stop it all. His nose was still raped by the stench, but as the seconds passed, the stench no longer burned, but rather it just kept turning his stomach, with a slight nausea on the side. Meanwhile, stars popped and faded in his vision as a result of the troglodyte sneeze.
f79c64bc0a9b.t: Orang asing itu menekupkan tangannya ke mata dan telinganya, cuba menghentikan semuanya. Hidungnya masih dirogol bau busuk itu, tetapi detik demi detik berlalu, bau itu tidak lagi membakar, sebaliknya hanya terus memualkan perutnya, dengan sedikit loya sebagai tambahan. Sementara itu, bintang-bintang muncul dan pudar dalam penglihatannya akibat bersin seperti orang gua itu.

f7f9d76cd26e.en: Chapter II subchapter 1: a heavy man in glasses and underwear slouches in an armchair in a dark room, with bottles and snacks.
f7f9d76cd26e.t: Bab II subbab 1: seorang lelaki gemuk berkaca mata dan berseluar dalam terbaring malas di kerusi berlengan dalam bilik gelap, dengan botol-botol dan makanan ringan.

f80831805772.en: Neferteri’s elegant demeanor grew wary as Nina interrupted what she was about to say.
f80831805772.t: Gaya anggun Neferteri bertukar waspada apabila Nina memotong apa yang hendak dikatakannya.

f8ce60ae30f3.en: Harry’s ear picked up on the moan, while he felt her shiver in his hands; his brain immediately got swamped with an urge to rub his fingers all over her Darfaries veins, imagining the possibility of maybe licking it instead to see how she would react.
f8ce60ae30f3.t: Telinga Harry menangkap erangan itu, sementara dia merasakan gadis itu menggigil di tangannya; otaknya serta-merta dibanjiri desakan untuk menggosok jarinya di seluruh urat Darfaries gadis itu, membayangkan kemungkinan menjilatnya pula untuk melihat bagaimana reaksinya.

f91dabeeede8.en: He remembered something painful—he had had a heart attack in that same chair, and fell to the floor as he tried to reach for his cellphone. The memory felt so real, as if it had just happened. He grabbed his heart, thinking he was still having a heart attack, but instead he felt a normal heartbeat, and a cold sauce that now laid on his chest. I’m alive? But I?—where’s the light?—wait? Isn’t this the living room?
f91dabeeede8.t: Dia teringat sesuatu yang menyakitkan—dia pernah diserang sakit jantung di kerusi yang sama itu, dan jatuh ke lantai ketika cuba mencapai telefon bimbitnya. Ingatan itu terasa begitu nyata, seolah-olah baru sahaja berlaku. Dia memegang jantungnya, menyangka dia masih diserang sakit jantung, tetapi sebaliknya dia merasakan degupan jantung yang normal, dan sos sejuk yang kini terlekat di dadanya. Aku hidup? Tapi aku?—mana cahaya tu?—tunggu? Bukankah ini ruang tamu?

f9981abaac8c.en: N-A-R-I—nari? Huh? What is this? The stranger, with both hands, accidentally split the nari chain in half. His lips thinned into a nervous grin, while his hands quickly placed them back where he found them.
f9981abaac8c.t: N-A-R-I—nari? Hah? Apa benda ni? Orang asing itu, dengan kedua-dua tangan, terbelahkan rantai nari itu kepada dua tanpa sengaja. Bibirnya menipis menjadi sengihan gugup, sementara tangannya cepat-cepat meletakkannya semula di tempat dia menemuinya.

fa828249f6fa.en: “Wait. What’s the difference between Darfaries and—Wo—Wozefaries?” Harry couldn’t stop looking at her sheer cuteness; her maid clothing revealed a bit of her breasts, but not enough to be scandalous.
fa828249f6fa.t: “Kejap. Apa beza antara Darfaries dan—Wo—Wozefaries?” Harry tidak dapat berhenti memandang kecomelannya yang melampau; pakaian pembantu rumahnya mendedahkan sedikit buah dadanya, tetapi tidak cukup untuk menjadi skandal.

fe73e8fbfb08.en: Another memory that rose was of a place that looked like a cubicle farm. He knew he spent most of his time there, but he did not know why. Not that it mattered as it passed by, and disappeared into the darkness.
fe73e8fbfb08.t: Satu lagi ingatan yang timbul ialah sebuah tempat yang kelihatan seperti ladang kubikel. Dia tahu dia menghabiskan sebahagian besar masanya di situ, tetapi dia tidak tahu mengapa. Bukannya penting pun kerana ia berlalu, dan lenyap ke dalam kegelapan.

feb410350706.en: Reaching the floor below, the floor setup was nearly the same, two main doors, one right in front of the stairs, and another to the side. Nothing special, but nothing familiar either.
feb410350706.t: Sampai di tingkat bawah, susunan tingkat itu hampir sama, dua pintu utama, satu betul-betul di hadapan tangga, dan satu lagi di sisi. Tiada yang istimewa, tetapi tiada yang biasa juga.

ff63ce6a55bd.en: Something caught his attention, he saw a green thingy that looked thin and pointy, like a weird pole weapon. Picking it up, he saw it was composed of multiple small green woody objects covering a diamond-like stone, with each woody thing containing a red line that zig-zagged in pseudo-squares, connecting to each other in the middle point of the left, and right borders.
ff63ce6a55bd.t: Sesuatu menarik perhatiannya, dia ternampak benda hijau yang kelihatan nipis dan tajam, seperti senjata galah yang pelik. Memungutnya, dia nampak ia terdiri daripada beberapa objek kayu kecil berwarna hijau yang menutupi batu seperti berlian, dengan setiap benda kayu itu mengandungi garis merah yang berzig-zag dalam bentuk seakan-akan segi empat, bersambung antara satu sama lain di titik tengah sempadan kiri dan kanan.
